From World Action Models to Embodied Brains: A Roadmap for Open-World Physical Intelligence WorldModel

World Action Models embodied brain physical-intelligence stack vision-language-action policies modular system composition

简要说明：本文综述了世界行动模型（WAMs）的演变，这些模型将候选干预措施与预测后果联系起来，并提出了一个具身大脑的路线图——一个模块化的物理智能堆栈，整合多模态上下文、状态转换/能力请求和闭环后训练，以实现自适应和自我改进的具身智能体。

TLDR: This paper reviews the evolution of World Action Models (WAMs) that connect candidate interventions with predicted consequences and proposes a roadmap for an embodied brain—a modular physical-intelligence stack integrating multimodal context, state-transition/capability requests, and closed-loop post-training for adaptive embodied agents.

Abstract: Artificial general intelligence ultimately requires agents that can reason and act in the physical world. Action models, vision-language-action policies, and world models have advanced this goal, while World Action Models (WAMs) are particularly promising because they connect candidate interventions with predicted consequences. However, progress remains fragmented: models use incompatible action spaces and prediction targets, datasets and tasks follow different conventions, and runtime systems expose limited interfaces for reuse and evaluation. We review the evolution toward WAMs and organize these limitations into three coupled gaps: model roles and representations, objectives and standardization, and system composition. Building on this analysis, we propose a co-evolution roadmap for physical intelligence centered on the \emph{embodied brain}, a long-term model target for integrating multimodal context, comparing candidate interventions, and issuing state-transition or capability requests rather than direct actuator commands. WAMs provide promising prototypes for its predictive functions, while a physical harness grounds model outputs through tools, controllers, verification, and trace logging. Shared contracts align heterogeneous models, data, tasks, and embodiments, and closed-loop post-training converts verified interaction into reusable experience. Together, these components define a modular physical-intelligence stack for adaptive and self-improving embodied agents.

摘要（中文）：通用人工智能最终需要能够在物理世界中推理和行动的智能体。行动模型、视觉-语言-行动策略以及世界模型已推动这一目标取得进展，而世界行动模型因其能将候选干预与预测后果相关联而尤为值得关注。然而，当前进展仍呈现碎片化态势：模型采用互不兼容的行动空间与预测目标，数据集与任务遵循不同规范，运行时系统对复用和评估仅提供有限的接口。本文梳理了世界行动模型的演进历程，并将这些局限归纳为三个相互关联的缺口：模型角色与表征、目标与标准化、以及系统组合。基于此分析，我们提出一种以具身大脑为核心的物理智能协同演进路线图——具身大脑作为长期模型目标，负责整合多模态情境、比较候选干预方案，并发出状态转换或能力请求而非直接执行器指令。世界行动模型为其预测功能提供了有前景的原型，而物理约束平台则通过工具、控制器、验证和追踪日志来 grounding 模型输出。共享契约可协调异构模型、数据、任务和具身形态，闭环后训练则将经过验证的交互转化为可复用的经验。这些组件共同构成模块化的物理智能堆栈，用于构建自适应且持续自我改进的具身智能体。

Authors: Yuanzhi Liang, Xufeng Zhan, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li

Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model WorldModel

world foundation model embodied generation multimodal autoregressive model multi-view scene generation embodied transfer

简要说明：Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 是一个 380 亿参数的多模态自回归模型，统一了场景生成、迁移和视频生成等具身任务，在保持基础模型泛化能力的同时实现多视角一致和机器人约束的合成，并在真实操作任务中提升了成功率。

TLDR: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is a 38B multimodal autoregressive model that unifies embodied generation tasks including scene generation, transfer, and video generation, preserving generalization from foundation models while enabling structured multi-view and robot-consistent synthesis, and improves real-world manipulation success rates.

Abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model for unified embodied synthesis. It treats embodied generation as an extension of foundation image and video generation and jointly optimizes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. This unified framework preserves the generalization of the pre-trained world foundation model while adapting it to embodied settings. Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is the first model to support high-quality multi-view scene generation across multiple robot embodiments and to introduce structured, controllable embodied transfer for fine-grained editing while preserving multi-view consistency and interaction dynamics. It achieves state-of-the-art results on single-step and sequential generation tasks, outperforming GPT-Image-2.0 in human evaluations of embodied scene generation and transfer, ranking first on World Arena for embodied video generation, and improving the out-of-distribution success rate of pi_0.5 from 36.9% to 63.2% on challenging real-world manipulation tasks. These results show that foundation world models can serve both as embodied world models and scalable data engines for embodied intelligence. Code and checkpoints are available at https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-u0.html.

摘要（中文）：最近的基础图像与视频生成模型展现了强大的泛化能力与可控性，但其直接应用于具身智能场景时，受限于多视图一致性、几何连贯性及机器人具身约束等要求。现有方法通常利用有限的机器人数据对基础模型进行适配，往往牺牲了大规模预训练过程中习得的视觉知识。我们提出小米机器人U0——一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型，用于统一的具身合成任务。该模型将具身生成视为基础图像与视频生成的延伸，联合优化了文本到图像生成、图像编辑、具身场景生成、具身迁移及具身视频生成等任务。这一统一框架在保留预训练世界基础模型泛化能力的同时，使其适配至具身场景。小米机器人U0是首个支持跨多种机器人形态的高质量多视角场景生成的模型，并引入了结构化、可控的具身迁移技术，在保持多视角一致性与交互动态性的前提下实现细粒度编辑。该模型在单步与序列生成任务中均取得最先进成果：在具身场景生成与迁移的人类评估中超越GPT-Image-2.0，在具身视频生成的World Arena排行榜中位列第一，并将pi_0.5在具有挑战性的真实世界操控任务上的分布外成功率从36.9%提升至63.2%。这些结果表明，基础世界模型既可作为具身世界模型，亦可作为具身智能的可扩展数据引擎。代码与模型权重详见https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-u0.html。

Authors: Xinghang Li, Jun Guo, Qiwei Li, Long Qian, Hang Lai, Yueze Wang, Hongyu Yan, Jiahang Cao, Xi Chen, Jingen Qu, Jiaxi Song, Nan Sun, Hanye Zhao, Futeng Liu, Wanli Peng, Heyun Wang, Yunhong Wang, Caoyu Xia, Jack Zhao, Diyun Xiang, Hangjun Ye, Heng Qu, Huaping Liu, Jason Li

PAKE: Learning Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with Partial Kinematic Embeddings Manipulation

loco-manipulation kinematic normalizing flow whole-body control quadrupedal robot partial reference motion

简要说明：提出一种全身移动操控框架，利用运动学归一化流生成部分参考运动，并通过高层控制器在其潜空间中导航，在带六自由度机械臂的四足机器人上实现了精确跟踪。

TLDR: Proposes a whole-body loco-manipulation framework that uses a kinematic normalizing flow to generate partial reference motions and a high-level controller to navigate its latent space, achieving precise tracking on a quadruped with a 6-DoF arm.

Abstract: Loco-manipulation has recently shown promising capabilities; however, achieving high-precision control, managing the high-dimensional action space induced by many degrees of freedom (DoFs), and fully exploiting the inherent redundancy of whole-body systems remain challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel whole-body control framework that effectively addresses these challenges by decomposing the complex loco-manipulation problem into partial reference motion generation and low-level imitation control. We introduce a new Kinematic Normalizing Flow (KNF) model, trained on a large-scale kinematic dataset, that generates diverse yet feasible partial reference motions. A high-level controller is then trained to navigate the KNF's latent space to exploit redundant solutions, while a low-level controller ensures physically feasible and accurate motion execution. We validate our approach on the quadrupedal robot equipped with a six-DoF robotic arm. In simulation, experimental results show that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of tracking accuracy and feasible workspace coverage. For hardware deployment, we evaluate the system over 24 episodes across 8 different mobile loco-manipulation tasks. The system achieves end-effector pose-tracking errors of 4.5 cm and 0.14 rad, while maintaining accurate locomotion tracking with linear and angular velocity errors of 0.1 m/s and 0.01 rad/s, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. Our method represents a practical and powerful solution for accurate and generalized whole-body loco-manipulation in high-DoF robotic systems, with promising potential for diverse downstream robotic tasks.

摘要（中文）：移动操作近年来展现出广阔前景，但实现高精度控制、应对多自由度引发的高维动作空间、以及充分挖掘全身系统固有冗余性仍面临挑战。本文提出一种新型全身控制框架，通过将复杂的移动操作问题解耦为局部参考运动生成与底层模仿控制，有效解决了上述难题。我们引入新型运动学归一化流（KNF）模型，该模型基于大规模运动学数据集训练，可生成多样且可行的局部参考运动。随后训练高层控制器以探索KNF潜空间来利用冗余解，同时底层控制器确保物理可行且精准的运动执行。我们在配备六自由度机械臂的四足机器人上验证了该方法。仿真实验结果表明，本方法在跟踪精度与可行工作空间覆盖率方面显著优于现有最优方法。在硬件部署中，我们通过8种不同移动操作任务的24轮次测试对系统进行评估。系统末端执行器位姿跟踪误差为4.5厘米和0.14弧度，同时保持线速度误差0.1米/秒、角速度误差0.01弧度/秒的精准运动跟踪，性能超越竞争基线方法。本方法为高自由度机器人系统实现精准且泛化的全身移动操作提供了实用且强大的解决方案，在多样化下游机器人任务中展现出巨大潜力。

Authors: Zhengmao He, Moonkyu Jung, Hyeongjun Kim, Jiseong Lee, Hui Zhang, Jemin Hwangbo, Jie Song

Mixture of Frames Policy: Multi-Frame Action Denoising for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

diffusion policy multi-frame action denoising SE(3) action parameterization bimanual mobile manipulation mixture of experts

简要说明：本文提出帧混合策略 (MoF)，一种基于扩散的视觉运动策略，通过列式6D旋转表示在多个坐标帧上同步动作去噪，提升了仿真和真实世界中的双臂移动操作性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes Mixture of Frames Policy (MoF), a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that performs synchronized action denoising across multiple coordinate frames with a column-based 6D rotation representation, improving bimanual mobile manipulation in both simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently multi-frame: local actions may be simple in an end-effector frame, while transport, upright-object handling, and whole-body coordination are better represented in a base-aligned frame. However, modern diffusion-based visuomotor policies typically commit to a single predefined action frame, forcing one denoiser to model action distributions that are often unnecessarily complex in that frame. We propose Mixture of Frames Policy (MoF), a diffusion policy that performs synchronized action denoising across multiple coordinate frames. MoF maintains a single canonical diffusion state, re-expresses it in several task-relevant frames, applies frame-specialized denoisers, and fuses their noise predictions back in the canonical frame. To make this possible for intermediate noisy diffusion states, we introduce a column-based 6D rotation representation within an SE(3) action parameterization that supports exact, differentiable frame transformations without requiring noisy rotations to lie on the SO(3) manifold. Across nine simulated bimanual manipulation tasks, we show that the best action frame is task-dependent and that MoF improves over oracle frame selection and standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) baselines. We further evaluate MoF on two real-world bimanual mobile manipulation tasks, demonstrating that it outperforms all constituent single-frame baselines. Project homepage: https://mofpo.github.io

摘要（中文）：机器人操作本质上是多帧的：局部动作在末端执行器坐标系中可能很简单，而搬运、立式物体操作及全身协调则在基于基座的坐标系中表现更佳。然而，现代基于扩散的视觉运动策略通常采用单一预定义的动作坐标系，迫使一个去噪器对在该坐标系下往往过于复杂的动作分布进行建模。我们提出"混合框架策略"(MoF)，这是一种跨多个坐标系统进行同步动作去噪的扩散策略。MoF维护单一规范扩散状态，将其在多个任务相关坐标系中重新表达，应用坐标系专用去噪器，并将其噪声预测结果融合回规范坐标系。为实现含噪中间扩散状态下的这一过程，我们引入基于列向量的六维旋转表示（嵌入SE(3)动作参数化），该方法支持精确可微的坐标系变换，而无需含噪旋转量位于SO(3)流形上。在九个仿真双臂操作任务中，我们证明最佳动作坐标系具有任务依赖性，且MoF优于最优坐标系选择及标准混合专家(MoE)基线方法。我们进一步在两个真实世界双臂移动操作任务中评估MoF，证明其优于所有构成性单坐标系基线方法。项目主页：https://mofpo.github.io

Authors: Dian Wang, Jisang Park, Xiaomeng Xu, Han Zhang, Shuran Song, Jeannette Bohg

A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation retargeting residual reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer human demonstration

简要说明：本文提出 REGRIND，一种极简流水线，通过将单次人类演示重定向为机器人参考并利用残差强化学习学习灵巧操作策略，实现了多指手在接触丰富任务（如使用剪刀和螺丝刀）上的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents REGRIND, a minimalist pipeline that retargets a single human demonstration to a robot reference and uses residual RL to learn dexterous manipulation policies, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on multi-fingered hands for contact-rich tasks like scissors and screwdriver.

Abstract: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.

摘要（中文）：近日，人形机器人全身控制领域的研究通过一种简洁的方法取得成功：将人体运动重定向至机器人运动学参考轨迹，再通过强化学习(RL)训练策略进行跟踪。然而，这一方法能否适用于灵巧操作？答案并不明确，因为灵巧操作涉及复杂的接触动力学，并需要精细调控接触模式与接触力。我们提出REGRIND——一种极简的重定向引导式强化学习流程，仅需一次人类演示即可学习灵巧操作策略。该流程将手-物运动重定向至保留空间位置与接触关系的机器人参考轨迹，在仿真环境中训练以物体为中心的关键点跟踪残差强化学习策略，并通过精密的系统辨识将所得策略零样本迁移至实体硬件。由此生成的策略在两种多指机械手上均展现出流畅、类人的操作行为，可完成剪刀操作与螺丝刀旋拧等接触密集工具使用任务。通过系统性硬件实验，我们识别并分析了影响灵巧操作仿真到现实迁移的关键因素，为基于重定向的接触密集场景学习提供了实践指导。视频与代码已开源至https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND。

Authors: Yunhai Feng, Natalie Leung, Jiaxuan Wang, Lujie Yang, Haozhi Qi, Preston Culbertson

NeuralActuator: Neural Actuation Modeling for Robot Dynamics and External Force Perception Manipulation

neural actuator model sim-to-real sensorless force perception actuation dataset differentiable simulation

简要说明：NeuralActuator 学习了一个神经执行器模型，从位姿轨迹预测扭矩代理、外力和电机状态评分，提高了低成本机器人仿真器的逼真度并实现了无传感器力感知；同时引入了多机器人执行数据集 (NAD)。

TLDR: NeuralActuator learns a neural actuator model that predicts torque surrogates, external forces, and motor condition scores from pose trajectories, improving simulator fidelity and enabling sensorless force perception on low-cost robots; it also introduces a multi-robot actuation dataset (NAD).

Abstract: Differentiable simulators have advanced policy learning and model-based control, yet actuator dynamics remain an important source of sim-to-real error. This is particularly acute on low-cost platforms, where the linear current-to-torque relation $τ= K_tI$ becomes unreliable during commanded-target tracking because of friction, hysteresis, backlash, and thermal effects. We present NeuralActuator, a neural actuator model that jointly predicts (i) a simulator-equivalent generalized-effort surrogate for trajectory propagation on low-cost servo platforms, (ii) external force with a contact-probability gate for sensorless force perception, and (iii) a motor-condition score for the supervised joint. We also introduce the Neural Actuation Dataset (NAD), collected with a twin-arm teleoperation system that records robot states and actuator telemetry together with external-force labels. The torque-surrogate head is trained through differentiable simulation from pose trajectories without direct generalized-effort labels, while the force, gate, and motor-condition heads receive direct supervision. A Transformer captures temporal dependencies while supporting real-time inference. We evaluate NeuralActuator on a 5-DoF OpenManipulator-X, a 6-DoF SO-101, and a 7-DoF Franka Emika Panda, spanning three actuator families and platforms costing approximately USD 500 to over USD 30,000. The low-cost platforms support dynamics and force evaluation, while the offline Franka experiment provides an additional payload-force-estimation benchmark. Experiments further demonstrate its application for motor condition estimation on OpenManipulator-X and improved behavior-cloning performance when NeuralActuator is used as a pretrained module.

摘要（中文）：可微分仿真器推动了策略学习与基于模型的控制的发展，然而执行器动力学仍然是导致仿真到现实误差的重要来源。这一问题在低成本平台上尤为突出，由于摩擦、迟滞、回差和热效应等因素，线性电流-力矩关系 $τ= K_tI$ 在指令目标跟踪过程中变得不可靠。我们提出NeuralActuator——一个神经执行器模型，该模型联合预测：(i) 用于低成本伺服平台轨迹传播的等效于仿真器的广义力替代量，(ii) 通过接触概率门控实现无传感器力感知的外力，以及(iii) 用于监督关节的电机状态评分。我们还引入了神经驱动数据集（NAD），该数据集通过双臂遥操作系统采集，记录了机器人状态、执行器遥测数据以及外力标签。力矩替代量头通过可微分仿真从位姿轨迹中训练，无需直接的广义力标签；而外力、门控和电机状态头则接受直接监督。Transformer模型在支持实时推理的同时捕捉时间依赖性。我们在5自由度OpenManipulator-X、6自由度SO-101和7自由度Franka Emika Panda上评估NeuralActuator，涵盖三个执行器系列及成本从约500美元到超过30,000美元的平台。低成本平台支持动力学和力评估，而离线Franka实验则提供了额外的负载力估计基准。实验进一步展示了其在OpenManipulator-X上用于电机状态估计的应用，以及将NeuralActuator作为预训练模块时对行为克隆性能的提升效果。

Authors: Zhiyang Dou, John U. Onyemelukwe, Hangxing Zhang, Heng Zhang, Minghao Guo, Yunsheng Tian, Michal Piotr Lipiec, Joshua Jacob, Chao Liu, Peter Yichen Chen, Yuri Ivanov, Wojciech Matusik

Automated Synthesis of Facial Mechanisms for Conversational Animatronic Robots HumanoidEmbodied

animatronic face mechanical synthesis facial motion synthesis conversational robot action unit

简要说明：本文提出了一种从单张2D肖像自动合成动画机器人面部机械结构的方法，采用参数化连杆模板和分层优化，并开发了用于说话和聆听的对话式面部运动合成框架。

TLDR: This paper presents an automated method for synthesizing the mechanical structure of animatronic robot faces from a single 2D portrait, using a parametric linkage template and hierarchical optimization, along with a conversational facial motion synthesis framework for speaking and listening.

Abstract: Animatronic faces are a central component of socially interactive robots, enabling rich nonverbal communication through facial articulation. However, state-of-the-art animatronic faces are typically tailored systems: each new facial geometry requires extensive manual mechanical redesign, making large-scale personalization prohibitively slow and costly. In this work, we pursue automated and scalable mechanical face synthesis, aiming to rapidly generate a physically realizable facial mechanism for a wide range of facial geometries. We introduce a parametric, linkage-driven mechanical face template whose topology and actuator layout are explicitly parameterized to support systematic scaling and retargeting across diverse facial morphologies. Building on this template, we propose a hierarchical automatic design algorithm that takes a single 2D portrait as input, reconstructs a target 3D face, and synthesizes a collision-free, manufacturable internal mechanism. The algorithm combines anatomy-guided feasible motion volumes, Action Unit (AU)-derived trajectory-based expressiveness objectives, and a collision-driven outer-loop refinement strategy. Beyond hardware synthesis, we argue that future mechanical faces deployed at scale must engage in bidirectional, multi-turn conversation rather than functioning solely as speaking or listening heads. To this end, we develop a dual-identity conversational facial motion synthesis framework that jointly models speaking and listening behaviors from audio, producing temporally coherent 3D facial motion suitable for physical execution. We validate our system through extensive experiments, including (i) quantitative evaluation of automatic mechanism synthesis across diverse facial geometries, (ii) comparisons against manual mechanical design, (iii) benchmarks on conversational facial motion synthesis and real-time deployment, and (iv) perceptual user studies.

摘要（中文）：动画机械面部是社交交互型机器人的核心组成部分，通过面部关节运动实现丰富的非语言交流。然而，现有最先进的动画机械面部通常是定制化系统：每款新面部的几何形状都需要大量的人工机械重新设计，使得大规模个性化定制过程极其缓慢且成本高昂。在本研究中，我们致力于实现自动化、可扩展的机械面部合成，旨在针对多种面部几何形状快速生成物理可实现的机械结构。我们引入了一种参数化、连杆驱动的机械面部模板，其拓扑结构和执行器布局经过显式参数化设计，以支持跨不同面部形态的系统性缩放与重定向。基于此模板，我们提出了一种分层自动设计算法：以单张二维肖像为输入，重建出目标三维面部，并合成一个无碰撞、可制造的内部机械结构。该算法融合了解剖学指导的可行运动空间、基于动作单元(AU)的轨迹驱动表情优化目标，以及碰撞驱动外循环优化策略。除硬件合成外，我们认为未来大规模部署的机械面部必须能够参与双向、多轮对话，而不仅仅是作为说话或听话的头像。为此，我们开发了一种双身份对话式面部运动合成框架，能够从音频中联合建模说话与倾听行为，生成适合物理执行的时间连贯三维面部运动。我们通过大量实验验证了该系统，包括：(i) 针对不同面部几何形状的自动机械合成定量评估，(ii) 与人工机械设计的对比，(iii) 对话式面部运动合成及实时部署的基准测试，以及 (iv) 感知用户研究。

Authors: Zongzheng Zhang, Zi Lin, Jiawen Yang, Ziqiao Peng, Junyan Lao, Lin Cheng, Huazhe Xu, Hang Zhao, Hao Zhao

DA-Nav: Direction-Aware City-Scale Vision-Language Navigation VLN

direction-aware navigation vision-language navigation spatial grounding Chain-of-Thought reasoning outdoor navigation

简要说明：DA-Nav 将城市规模户外导航重新定义为基于第一人称图像的方向感知离散空间定位问题，利用商业导航工具的方向指令，在 CARLA 中取得高成功率，并零样本迁移至真实四足和人形机器人。

TLDR: DA-Nav reformulates city-scale outdoor navigation as discrete spatial grounding on egocentric images using directional instructions from commercial tools, achieving high success in CARLA and zero-shot transfer to real-world quadruped and humanoid robots.

Abstract: City-scale outdoor navigation is currently hindered by the heavy reliance on dense maps or costly navigation supervision. In this work, we introduce a novel paradigm for leveraging directional instructions from commercial navigation tools (e.g., Google Maps). To bridge the gap between commercial instructions and executable navigation actions, while mitigating long-horizon error accumulation through robust trajectory recovery, we propose DA-Nav, a Direction-Aware vision-language Navigation framework that reformulates navigation as a discrete spatial grounding problem on the egocentric 2D image plane. To achieve trajectory recovery, DA-Nav employs a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process encompassing deviation assessment, action prediction, and target grid selection. We further introduce ReDA, a dataset that provides direction-aware instructions and recovery trajectories to enhance spatial grounding and support CoT recovery reasoning. Extensive experiments in CARLA demonstrate that DA-Nav achieves a high success rate of 56.16% in unseen urban environments, outperforming existing State-of-The-Art (SoTA) methods while maintaining a substantially stronger recovery capability. Furthermore, without fine-tuning, DA-Nav seamlessly adapts to both quadruped and humanoid robots, enabling stable kilometer-scale closed-loop outdoor navigation in complex real world environments.

摘要（中文）：城市尺度的户外导航目前因对稠密地图或昂贵导航监督的过度依赖而受到阻碍。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种利用商业导航工具（如谷歌地图）方向指令的新范式。为弥合商业指令与可执行导航动作之间的差距，同时通过鲁棒的轨迹恢复减轻长时程误差累积，我们提出了DA-Nav——一种方向感知的视觉语言导航框架，该框架将导航重新定义为以自我为中心的二维图像平面上的离散空间定位问题。为实现轨迹恢复，DA-Nav采用包含偏差评估、动作预测和目标网格选择的思维链推理过程。我们进一步引入ReDA数据集，该数据集提供方向感知指令与恢复轨迹，以增强空间定位能力并支持思维链恢复推理。在CARLA中的大量实验表明，DA-Nav在未见过的城市环境中实现了56.16%的高成功率，在超越现有最先进方法的同时保持显著更强的恢复能力。此外，无需微调，DA-Nav即可无缝适配四足机器人和人形机器人，在复杂的真实世界环境中实现稳定的公里级闭环户外导航。

Authors: Ye Yuan, Kehan Chen, Xinqiang Yu, Wentao Xu, Heng Wang, Libo Huang, Chuanguang Yang, Yan Huang, Jiawei He, Zhulin An

SKooP: Symmetric Koopman Predictions for Faster and More Generalizable Legged Robot Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning Locomotion

Koopman model morphological symmetries equivariant policy legged locomotion reinforcement learning

简要说明：SKooP 利用形态对称性和通过自编码器学习的 Koopman 模型为评论家提供特权预测，从而加速和改善四足机器人上的腿部运动策略学习。

TLDR: SKooP combines morphological symmetries and a Koopman model learned via autoencoder to provide privileged predictions for the critic in RL, accelerating and improving legged locomotion policy learning on a quadruped robot.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms classically suffer from poor sample efficiency. In robotics, a recent line of work has emerged addressing this problem by encoding physics priors in the learning process. However, most of these approaches are validated on well-defined, low-dimensional benchmark systems rather than high-dimensional robots with complex nonlinear dynamics. In this paper, we introduce \textit{SKooP (Symmetric Koopman Predictions)}, an approach combining the advantages of morphological symmetries with those of a Koopman model learned via autoencoder to enhance policy learning. SKooP learns a Koopman model of the system dynamics alongside the policy. The resulting Koopman predictions are used as privileged observations for the critic, allowing the agent to learn based on smoother, more informative features. We also incorporate group symmetries into the actor, critic, encoder and decoder networks to produce a highly equivariant policy. The SKooP approach is validated via in-depth analysis of the learned Koopman models and symmetric policies to showcase how each of these influences the agent's performance. We also show that the learned policies are transferable to different simulation environments. Our results show that SKooP consistently reduces convergence time and increases the learned reward for multiple challenging bipedal locomotion tasks on a quadruped robot. Project page: https://evelyd.github.io/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions

摘要（中文）：强化学习算法传统上存在样本效率低下的问题。在机器人领域，近期一系列研究工作通过将物理先验编码到学习过程中来应对这一挑战。然而，这些方法大多是在定义明确、低维度的基准系统上进行验证，而非具有复杂非线性动力学的高维机器人。本文提出\textit{SKooP（对称库普曼预测）}方法，通过融合形态对称性与自编码器学习的库普曼模型优势来增强策略学习。SKooP在学习策略的同时建立系统动力学的库普曼模型，将生成的库普曼预测作为评论器的特权观测，使智能体能够基于更平滑、更具信息量的特征进行学习。我们还将在演员、评论器、编码器与解码器网络中引入群对称性，以构建高度等变的策略。通过对所学库普曼模型与对称策略的深入分析，我们验证了SKooP方法的有效性，并展示了各部分对智能体性能的影响。研究表明，学习到的策略可迁移至不同仿真环境。实验结果显示，在四足机器人多项具有挑战性的双足运动任务中，SKooP持续缩短了收敛时间并提升了奖励值。项目页面：https://evelyd.github.io/SymmetricKoopmanPredictions

Authors: Evelyn D'Elia, Weishu Zhan, Giulio Turrisi, Giulio Romualdi, Giuseppe L'Erario, Raffaello Camoriano, Wei Pan, Daniele Pucci

See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

robot-centric pointmaps VLA models frame mismatch camera viewpoint generalization 3D geometry

简要说明：提出以机器人为中心的点图，将场景点的3D坐标编码为图像像素，消除VLA模型中相机观测与动作定义的坐标系不匹配问题，提升了策略跨视角的泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes robot-centric pointmaps that encode 3D scene points in the robot's coordinate frame as image pixels, eliminating the frame mismatch between camera observation and action definition in VLA models, improving policy generalization across camera viewpoints.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型根据视觉观察和语言指令预测机器人动作。这些动作定义在机器人自身的3D坐标系中，但大多数VLA模型通过相机视角观察场景，导致场景观测与动作定义之间存在坐标系不匹配。在固定视角下，这种不匹配尚可接受——策略能记忆单一的观测-动作映射关系——但当大规模数据集聚合来自不同相机设置的演示、策略需跨视角泛化该映射时，问题便愈发棘手。我们通过以机器人为中心的点图解决此不匹配：这种图像的像素存储场景点在机器人坐标系中的3D坐标。点图在保留预训练2D VLA所需的密集H×W网格结构的同时，提供了机器人坐标系下的3D几何信息，从而能以最小架构改动集成到现有VLA中。在RoboCasa上，点图同时提升了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，并优于代表性相机视角及3D感知基线方法。在真实机器人实验中，当相机被移至训练中未出现的位置时，点图相比纯RGB策略的优势更为显著。

Authors: Byungkun Lee, Dongyoon Hwang, Dongjin Kim, Hojoon Lee, Minho Park, Jaegul Choo

Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation Manipulation

dexterous teleoperation hand-object co-tracking reinforcement learning domain randomization behavioral cloning

简要说明：TeleDexter 提出了一种手-物协同跟踪控制器，通过单阶段强化学习和域随机化在真实机器人手上实现人类级别的灵巧遥操作，支持零样本迁移并通过行为克隆成功学习策略。

TLDR: TeleDexter introduces a hand-object co-tracking controller that uses single-stage RL and domain randomization to achieve human-level dexterous teleoperation on real robot hands, enabling zero-shot transfer and successful policy learning via behavioral cloning.

Abstract: Humans routinely wield tools, swap grasps, and reposition objects within a single hand, seamlessly orchestrating contact transitions that span translation, reorientation, and finger gaiting. Endowing robot dexterous hands with this level of in-hand dexterity through teleoperation requires precise control of object motion via dynamic hand-object contact, yet current teleoperation systems remain far from this capability. To bridge this gap, we take a major step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation by introducing TeleDexter, a hand-object co-tracking controller that maps operator intent into learned, low-level contact execution. The controller is trained on consecutive co-tracking subgoals derived from human reference motions, utilizing a hybrid reward that couples sparse subgoal objectives with dense tracking rewards to enable learning across diverse interaction modalities rather than frame-wise trajectory imitation. The entire pipeline requires only single-stage RL and, with random action masking and domain randomization, transfers zero-shot to the real robot. We evaluate TeleDexter on seven challenging dexterous teleoperation tasks spanning object reorientation and long-horizon tool use across two dexterous hands, achieving a 75% average success rate where all baselines consistently fail. Furthermore, the collected demonstrations successfully train autonomous policies via behavioral cloning, marking a concrete step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：人类日常使用工具时，能自如地切换抓取方式、在单只手掌内重新定位物体，无缝协调涵盖平移、重定向与手指步态的接触转换。通过遥操作赋予机器人灵巧手这种级别的掌内灵巧性，需要借助动态手物接触精确控制物体运动，然而现有遥操作系统远未达到这一能力。为弥合这一差距，我们向人类级灵巧遥操作迈出关键一步，提出TeleDexter——一种手物协同跟踪控制器，可将操作者意图映射为经过学习的底层接触执行策略。该控制器基于人类参考运动推导的连续协同跟踪子目标进行训练，采用混合奖励机制：将稀疏子目标与密集跟踪奖励相结合，使其能学习多样交互模式而非逐帧轨迹模仿。整个流程仅需单阶段强化学习，通过随机动作掩码与域随机化，即可零样本迁移至真实机器人。我们在涵盖物体重定向与长时程工具使用的七项灵巧遥操作任务中，对两种灵巧手进行测试，在所有基线均失败的场景下达到75%的平均成功率，且收集的示范数据可通过行为克隆成功训练自主策略，这标志着向人类级灵巧遥操作迈出了实质性一步。

Authors: Puhao Li, Zeyuan Chen, Yingying Wu, Pengkun Wei, Yuyang Li, Tianyu Wang, Jiaxiao Shi, Mingrui Yu, Baoxiong Jia, Song-chun Zhu, Tengyu Liu, Siyuan Huang

EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

action representation environment-dependent robotic manipulation visual consequences policy learning

简要说明：本文提出EDAR，一种学习环境相关动作表征的方法，通过将电机命令与预期的视觉结果相结合，提升了机器人操作策略的学习效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces EDAR, a method that learns environment-dependent action representations by grounding motor commands in both control structure and expected visual consequences, improving policy learning for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Learning effective action representations is critical for robotic manipulation, where raw control trajectories are often noisy, redundant, and difficult to model directly. Existing methods mainly encode the structure of the action stream itself, treating the role of actions in the environment as implicit. Yet manipulation is about changing the world: the same action segment can induce different outcomes under different scene contexts, making action semantics inherently environment-dependent. We propose EDAR, an Environment-Dependent Action Representation that grounds action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences. By coupling motor commands with their environment-conditioned effects, EDAR encourages the learned action space to capture interaction semantics rather than merely command-level patterns. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that EDAR improves downstream policy learning, especially in long-horizon manipulation. These results highlight the importance of grounding action representations in executable control structure and environment-conditioned visual change.

摘要（中文）：学习有效的动作表征对于机器人操作至关重要，原始控制轨迹通常包含噪声、冗余信息且难以直接建模。现有方法主要对动作流本身的结构进行编码，将动作在环境中的作用视为隐式因素。然而操作的本质在于改变世界：同一动作片段在不同场景情境下可能引发截然不同的结果，这使得动作语义本质上依赖于环境。我们提出EDAR——一种环境依赖型动作表征方法，将动作标记同时锚定于可执行控制结构与预期视觉结果。通过将运动指令与其环境条件化效应相结合，EDAR促使所学动作空间捕捉交互语义，而不仅仅是命令层面的模式。在仿真与真实机器人操作基准测试上的实验表明，EDAR能够提升下游策略学习性能，特别是在长时域操作任务中。这些结果凸显了将动作表征锚定于可执行控制结构与环境条件化视觉变化的重要性。

Authors: Yuecheng Xu, Tong Yang, Jingkai Jia, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li, Wenqiang Zhang

WALA Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos VLA

latent action model action-free videos DINOv3 features dense depth robotic manipulation

简要说明：WALA从有动作标签的机器人演示和无动作标签的视频中学习可执行的潜在动作，利用DINOv3特征和深度图建模语义-几何潜在动作，在RoboTwin、RoboCasa和真实世界操作任务中取得了优异表现。

TLDR: WALA learns executable latent actions from both action-labeled robot demos and action-free videos by modeling semantic-geometric latent actions, using DINOv3 features and dense depth, and shows strong results on RoboTwin, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: Generalizable robot policies typically rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations, which are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, large-scale human and robot videos contain rich physical interactions but often lack executable robot action labels. We present WALA, a framework for learning executable latent actions from both action-labeled demonstrations and action-free videos. WALA first pretrains a semantic-geometric latent action model from videos by modeling the evolution between current observations and sparsely sampled future observations. Instead of reconstructing raw pixels, WALA predicts future deltas in the DINOv3 feature space and dense depth space, preserving task-relevant semantic and geometric structure while reducing sensitivity to appearance details. During policy training, the pretrained encoder provides stable latent action targets, and the decoder serves as a trainable latent world model. The latent actions generated by the vision-language backbone are jointly supervised by robot action prediction, latent action target matching, and future dynamics prediction. This enables action-labeled demonstrations to provide executable control supervision, while action-free videos contribute dynamics supervision without requiring robot action annotations. Experiments show that WALA achieves strong performance on RoboTwin, sets a new state-of-the-art result on RoboCasa with 75.2% average success, and improves both policy performance and generalization in real-world manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：可泛化机器人策略通常依赖于带有动作标签的机器人示教数据，这些数据采集成本高昂且难以扩展。相比之下，大规模人类与机器人视频包含丰富的物理交互信息，但往往缺乏可执行的机器人动作标签。我们提出WALA框架，该框架能够从带有动作标签的示教数据和无动作视频中学习可执行的潜在动作。WALA首先通过建模当前观测与稀疏采样未来观测之间的演变过程，基于视频预训练一个语义-几何潜在动作模型。该模型不重建原始像素，而是预测DINOv3特征空间和密集深度空间中的未来变化量，在保留任务相关语义与几何结构的同时降低对外观细节的敏感性。在策略训练阶段，预训练编码器提供稳定的潜在动作目标，解码器则作为可训练的潜在世界模型。由视觉-语言主干网络生成的潜在动作同时受机器人动作预测、潜在动作目标匹配及未来动力学预测的联合监督。这使得带动作标签的示教数据能够提供可执行控制监督，而无动作视频则无需机器人动作标注即可贡献动力学监督。实验表明，WALA在RoboTwin上表现优异，在RoboCasa上以75.2%的平均成功率取得最新最优结果，并在真实世界操作任务中同时提升了策略性能与泛化能力。

Authors: Jiahao Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Shuai Tian, Huangrui Li, Yuhang Zheng, Ning Ma, Xin Fu, Xiaotian Liu, Jing Li, Yixian Li, ShangQing Zhou, Zebin Xing, Linbo Wang, Chaoyue Li, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao

A Glimpse into Long-term Physical Coexistence with Intelligent Robots HumanoidEmbodied

multi-robot agent robot gateway long-horizon memory human-robot interaction household service tasks

简要说明：PHILIA 提出了一种多机器人智能体架构，通过机器人网关抽象将高层推理与底层执行解耦，实现了对多样化用户界面、机器人形态和策略的灵活集成，以支持长期的家庭共存。

TLDR: PHILIA introduces a multi-robot agent architecture with a robot gateway abstraction that decouples high-level reasoning from low-level execution, enabling flexible integration of diverse user interfaces, robot embodiments, and policies for long-term domestic coexistence.

Abstract: Long-term physical coexistence with intelligent robots requires more than capable robot policies. A persistent robotic assistant must support diverse user-facing interfaces, maintain long-horizon memory of people and preferences, coordinate across robot embodiments, and translate human intent into safe physical execution. We introduce PHILIA, a multi-robot agent built around a robot gateway abstraction. PHILIA retains the rich interaction and tool ecosystem of OpenClaw while exposing robot-local runtimes, onboard perception, navigation, speaker, and robot policies through a unified capability interface. This design decouples low-frequency, high-semantic agent reasoning from high-frequency, low-level robot execution, enabling plug-and-play integration of user interfaces, robot embodiments, and policy backends. As a result, the user experience becomes compositional: advances in user interfaces, robot embodiments, robot policies, navigation, or interaction algorithms can improve the overall experience without redesigning the system. We validate the architecture on Astribot S1 robots while designing the robot gateway contract to support future heterogeneous robot platforms through a shared capability interface for observation, task execution, navigation, speech playback, status monitoring, and task cancellation. We present representative use cases in which agent memory and scene understanding are grounded in robot actions. These span interactive household scenarios, ranging from simple organization to challenging long-horizon and dexterous service tasks, such as packing a backpack and lifting a garbage bag. We highlight the human-robot interaction flow, where contextual understanding of user intent and preferences, together with human-in-the-loop confirmation or adjustment during execution, is essential for effective assistance.

摘要（中文）：与智能机器人的长期物理共存不仅需要可靠的机器人策略。一个持久的机器人助手必须支持多样化的面向用户接口，维护关于人物与偏好的长周期记忆，协调跨机器人形态的协作，并将人类意图转化为安全的物理执行。我们提出PHILIA——一个基于机器人网关抽象构建的多机器人智能体。该系统保留了OpenClaw丰富的交互与工具生态系统，同时通过统一的能力接口暴露机器人本地运行时、机载感知、导航、扬声器及机器人策略。这种设计将低频、高语义的智能体推理与高频、低层级的机器人执行解耦，实现了用户界面、机器人形态及策略后端的即插即用集成。由此，用户体验呈现出组合性：用户界面、机器人形态、机器人策略、导航或交互算法的进步可在无需重新设计系统的前提下提升整体体验。我们在Astribot S1机器人上验证了该架构，同时通过共享能力接口（涵盖观测、任务执行、导航、语音播放、状态监控及任务取消）设计机器人网关协议，以支持未来异构机器人平台。我们展示了具身记忆与场景理解锚定于机器人动作的典型用例，这些场景涵盖从简单整理到挑战性的长周期及灵巧服务任务（如打包背包、提起垃圾袋）的交互式家居场景。我们重点突出人机交互流程，其中对用户意图与偏好的语境理解，结合执行过程中的人机协同确认或调整，对于实现有效辅助至关重要。

Authors: Weiqi Jin, Peijun Tang, Kuncheng Luo, Baifu Huang, Binyan Sun, Haotian Yang, Shangjin Xie, Jianan Wang

Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning VLA

latent world-action model predictive reasoning modality alignment vision-language-action embodied intelligence

简要说明：Lumo-2是一种潜在世界-动作模型，通过在潜在空间中推理学习到的世界动态来生成机器人动作，并采用多阶段模态预对齐策略提升跨模态一致性和控制性能。

TLDR: Lumo-2 is a latent world-action model that generates robot actions by reasoning over learned world dynamics in latent space, using a multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy to improve cross-modal consistency and control performance.

Abstract: Learning, at its core, extends beyond memorization to the ability to reason and solve novel problems by navigating a space of possibilities. We introduce Lumo-2, a latent world-action model that generates actions by reasoning over world dynamics in latent space. The learned latent world dynamics capture physically grounded visual transitions, naturally encoding future possibilities and providing a unified substrate for cross-modal alignment. This formulation enables predictive reasoning akin to world modelling while remaining lightweight and focused on physical dynamics relevant to control. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that action generation quality is governed by the geometry of the latent space. We observe that standard reconstruction-based action tokenization objectives induce representations biased toward low-level signal fidelity, leading to misalignment between reconstruction quality and downstream control performance. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy in which action representations are progressively aligned with latent world dynamics, vision, and language. This process enforces cross-modal consistency, promotes abstraction, and induces a structured latent space for predictive reasoning. We provide a systematic empirical study of latent world modelling and modality alignment, analyzing their roles in scaling laws and out-of-distribution generalization. Results show that Lumo-2 consistently outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) baselines, with gains on challenging real-world tasks requiring temporal reasoning, physical understanding, or high control complexity, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation. These findings suggest that structured multimodal alignment and predictive reasoning are fundamental principles for advancing embodied intelligence.

摘要（中文）：学习的本质超越记忆，其核心在于通过在可能性空间中进行探索来推理和解决新问题的能力。我们提出Lumo-2，一种潜在世界-行动模型，通过在潜在空间中对世界动态进行推理来生成行动。学习到的潜在世界动态捕捉了基于物理的视觉转换，天然地编码了未来可能性，并为跨模态对齐提供了统一的基底。这一公式使得模型能够在保持轻量级架构的同时，实现类似世界模型的预测推理，并专注于与控制相关的物理动态。我们方法的核心假设是：行动生成质量由潜在空间的几何结构决定。我们观察到，基于重建的标准行动分词目标会诱导表征偏向于低层级信号保真度，导致重建质量与下游控制性能之间的错配。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种多阶段模态预对齐策略，其中行动表征逐步与潜在世界动态、视觉和语言对齐。该过程强制实现跨模态一致性、促进抽象化，并诱导出用于预测推理的结构化潜在空间。我们对潜在世界建模和模态对齐进行了系统的实证研究，分析了它们在缩放定律和分布外泛化中的作用。结果表明，Lumo-2在需要时间推理、物理理解或高控制复杂度的挑战性真实世界任务（包括长时程和灵巧操作任务）中，始终优于强力的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）和世界-行动模型（WAM）基线。这些发现表明，结构化多模态对齐与预测推理是推动具身智能发展的基本原则。

Authors: Peijun Tang, Shangjin Xie, Baifu Huang, Binyan Sun, Haotian Yang, Kuncheng Luo, Weiqi Jin, Shilin Fang, Jianan Wang

Pix2Act: Image-Space Manipulation Policies with Equivariant Augmentation Manipulation

image-space keypoint trajectories equivariant augmentation imitation learning triangulation manipulation policies

简要说明：Pix2Act 将三维操控重新定义为在相机图像中预测二维关键点轨迹，通过联合旋转图像和动作实现等变数据增强，并利用三角测量恢复三维姿态，从而实现鲁棒的模仿学习。

TLDR: Pix2Act reformulates 3D manipulation as predicting 2D keypoint trajectories in camera images, enabling equivariant data augmentation through joint rotation of images and actions, and recovers 3D poses via triangulation for robust imitation learning.

Abstract: Representing manipulation actions as 2D trajectories in the camera plane provides a compact and interpretable basis for learning complex 3D manipulation policies. However, it also creates challenges from out-of-frame trajectories and limited precision. We propose Pix2Act, an imitation learning method that addresses these challenges by generating continuous image-space keypoint trajectories in each camera plane and losslessly recovering end-effector poses via triangulation. This reformulates high-dimensional 3D control as a simpler, more learnable 2D prediction problem. Crucially, it aligns observations and actions in the same coordinate space, enabling equivariant transformations to jointly rotate individual camera images together with their image-space actions. We analyze the symmetry properties of this augmentation and design a network architecture that can fuse multiple camera views while respecting their per-view rotations. As a result, Pix2Act implicitly enlarges the support of the data distribution and learns invariant action structures across transformations, yielding improved generalization and overall performance. Across diverse simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, Pix2Act outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and remains robust under camera perturbations.

摘要（中文）：将操作动作表示为相机平面中的二维轨迹，为学习复杂的三维操作策略提供了紧凑且可解释的基础。然而，这也带来了轨迹超出画面边界以及精度受限的挑战。我们提出Pix2Act，一种模仿学习方法，通过在每个相机平面中生成连续的图像空间关键点轨迹，并通过三角测量无损恢复末端执行器姿态，从而应对这些挑战。这将高维三维控制问题重新表述为更简单、更易于学习的二维预测问题。关键在于，它将观测与动作对齐到同一坐标空间，使得等变变换能够联合旋转单个相机图像及其图像空间动作。我们分析了这种增强方法的对称性特性，并设计了一种网络架构，该架构在融合多相机视图的同时，能够尊重每个视图各自的旋转。因此，Pix2Act隐含地扩大了数据分布的支持范围，并学习了跨变换的不变动作结构，从而提升了泛化能力与整体性能。在多种模拟和真实世界的操作任务中，Pix2Act超越了现有最优基线方法，并且在相机扰动下依然保持鲁棒性。

Authors: Haojie Huang, Linfeng Zhao, Haotian Liu, Zhang Ye, Si-Yuan Huang, Mingxi Jia, Boce Hu, Fangzhou Lin, Yu Qi, Dian Wang, Robin Walters, Robert Platt

Comparison-Based Ordinal Learning for Proactive Driving Risk Assessment AutonomousDriving

driving risk assessment ordinal learning proactive collision warning pairwise supervision naturalistic driving data

简要说明：提出一种基于比较的序数学习框架，通过成对监督学习驾驶风险评分，无需帧级标签，在自然驾驶数据集上改进了主动碰撞预警。

TLDR: Proposes a comparison-based ordinal learning framework that learns driving risk scores from pairwise supervision without frame-level labels, improving proactive collision warning on naturalistic driving datasets.

Abstract: Real-time driving risk assessment provides an essential basis for proactive safety by identifying and quantifying the danger of ongoing road interactions before adverse outcomes occur. However, due to the scarcity of collision data and frame-level risk labels, existing driving risk assessment methods often rely on surrogate objectives, which may imperfectly align with true collision risk and not faithfully reflect the relative danger of driving interaction. This paper proposes a comparison-based ordinal risk learning framework that learns collision-relevant risk scores from pairwise supervision in driving data, directly modeling relative risk ordering without requiring numerical frame-level risk labels. We derive pairwise comparisons from three sources of event-structured driving data for such ordinal risk learning: temporal progression within safety-critical sequences, event-level contrast between dangerous and normal interactions, and physics-based counterfactual perturbations. On this basis, instantiations with three risk-scoring function parameterizations are implemented, including directly learning risk scores from comparison data, and aligning existing single or multiple surrogate-based risk models. The proposed framework is evaluated on the 100-Car and SHRP2 naturalistic driving datasets using a proactive collision warning task. Results show that the proposed framework improves high-recall risk discrimination, warning precision, and warning lead time over representative surrogate-based baselines across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations. These results suggest that the proposed framework can contribute to proactive safety research by providing more reliable risk assessment for automated driving systems and safety-critical driving interactions.

摘要（中文）：实时驾驶风险评估通过在不安全结果发生前识别并量化道路交互过程中的危险程度，为主动安全提供了关键基础。然而，由于碰撞数据及帧级风险标签的稀缺性，现有驾驶风险评估方法常依赖替代目标函数，这些函数可能无法完美匹配真实碰撞风险，亦不能忠实反映驾驶交互的相对危险性。本文提出一种基于比较的序级风险学习框架，通过从驾驶数据中提取成对监督信号来学习与碰撞相关的风险评分，直接在无需数值化帧级风险标签的前提下对相对风险排序进行建模。我们基于三类事件结构化驾驶数据推导了用于序级风险学习的成对比较：安全关键序列中的时间演化特征、危险与正常交互之间的事件级对比，以及基于物理的反事实扰动。在此基础上，实现了三种风险评分函数参数化的实例化方法，包括直接从比较数据中学习风险评分，以及将现有单一或多重替代风险模型进行对齐。该框架在100-Car和SHRP2自然驾驶数据集上通过主动碰撞预警任务进行验证。结果表明，与基于代表性替代模型的基线方法相比，所提框架在分布内和分布外评估中均能提升高召回风险辨别能力、预警精度及预警提前时间。这些发现表明，该框架可为自动驾驶系统及安全关键驾驶交互提供更可靠的风险评估，从而推动主动安全研究发展。

Authors: Zhuoren Li, Yi Zhong, Weiqi Zhang, Xinrui Zhang, Lu Xiong, Chongfeng Wei, Bo Leng

VIA: Visual Interface Agent for Robot Control VLA

vision-language-action foundation model agent zero-shot robot control visual interface closed-loop control

简要说明：VIA 通过浏览器3D界面让前沿基础模型智能体（Claude Code, Codex）操控机器人，无需针对机器人微调即可零样本完成桌面操作任务。

TLDR: VIA uses frontier foundation model agents (Claude Code, Codex) to control a robot manipulator through a browser-based 3D interface, without any robot-specific fine-tuning, achieving strong zero-shot tabletop manipulation.

Abstract: Robot manipulation is a complex task that requires visual understanding, physical reasoning, planning, and closed-loop control. General-purpose foundation models (FMs) have grown remarkably capable of some of these, especially vision and reasoning. To leverage this for generalist robot policies, current methods typically involve converting existing FMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models by fine-tuning on robot data to output low-level actions. However, VLAs are often orders of magnitude smaller than frontier FMs given the limited data and compute available for fine-tuning, which in turn limits their general capability. Inspired by the growing ability of FMs to operate software through visual interfaces, we ask whether that same competence suffices to control a robot. We present VIA (Visual Interface Agent for robot control), a framework that recasts robot control as an agentic task: an off-the-shelf FM-powered agent drives a manipulator through a browser-based 3D interface by taking screenshots, issuing intuitive commands, observing the outcome, and adjusting. The agent receives no robot-specific fine-tuning and no access to privileged state information: it perceives visual input and acts through a small set of general tools. VIA inherits the agent's general reasoning, closed-loop error recovery, and ability to plan and re-plan from what it observes. It solves a diverse suite of tabletop manipulation tasks zero-shot with both Claude Code and Codex. With the strongest model (Fable 5) it achieves 96.7% success on three LIBERO-Goal tasks and 100% on a long-horizon rainbow assembly task. Performance improves with the scale and strength of the underlying model. These results suggest that frontier agents already possess skills that transfer directly to robot control given the right interface: your coding or computer-use agent is, in a sense, secretly a robot-control agent.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作是一项复杂的任务，需要视觉理解、物理推理、规划与闭环控制。通用基础模型（FMs）在部分能力上已取得显著进展，尤其是视觉与推理方面。为将这些能力应用于通用型机器人策略，当前方法通常将现有基础模型通过机器人数据微调，转化为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，以输出底层动作。然而，受限于微调时可用的数据量与算力，VLA模型的规模往往比前沿基础模型小数个数量级，这限制了其通用能力。受基础模型通过视觉界面操作软件的能力日益增强的启发，我们探究这种能力是否足以控制机器人。本文提出VIA（面向机器人控制的视觉界面智能体）框架，将机器人控制重构为一种智能体任务：由现成基础模型驱动的智能体，通过基于浏览器的3D界面操作机械臂——截取屏幕图像、发出直观指令、观察结果、进行调整。该智能体无需针对机器人进行微调，也无法访问特权状态信息：它仅通过视觉感知输入，通过一组通用工具执行操作。VIA继承了智能体的通用推理能力、闭环错误恢复能力，以及基于观察结果进行规划与重新规划的能力。在Claude Code和Codex平台上，该框架能以零样本方式解决一系列桌面操作任务。使用最强模型（Fable 5）时，其在三项LIBERO-Goal任务中达到96.7%的成功率，并在长时域彩虹组装任务中实现100%的成功率。性能随基础模型的规模与能力提升而改善。这些结果表明，前沿智能体已具备通过恰当界面直接迁移至机器人控制的技能：从某种意义上说，你的编程或计算机使用智能体，其实暗中已是一个机器人控制智能体。

Authors: Hengyuan Hu, Priya Sundaresan, Jensen Gao, Dorsa Sadigh

GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation Manipulation

dexterous grasp generation graph-structured hand representation multi-embodiment conditional flow matching kinematic graph

简要说明：一种基于图结构的多机械手灵巧抓取生成框架，无需后处理或重新定向即可为不同运动学结构的手生成可执行的抓取姿态。

TLDR: A graph-structured framework that generates dexterous grasps for multiple robot hands with different kinematic topologies, using a shared model without retargeting or post-processing.

Abstract: Dexterous grasp generation across robot hands is challenging because hands differ in kinematic topology, actuation dimensions, and native command spaces. We introduce GraspGraphNet, a topology-aware grasp generation framework that represents each hand as a URDF-derived kinematic graph and directly generates executable palm poses and joint configurations. GraspGraphNet combines hierarchical object surface encoding, differentiable forward kinematics, and dynamic world-edge message passing to model evolving robot-object interactions. It applies conditional flow matching directly in executable palm-pose and joint-state space, avoiding post-processing optimization, inverse kinematics, and retargeting. Using a shared model trained on Barrett Hand, Allegro Hand, and Shadow Hand, GraspGraphNet achieves an average success rate of 83.48% with 40ms inference time per grasp on a 40-object benchmark. Without retraining, the same model achieves 72.70% success on controlled finger-removal variants, demonstrating robustness to hand-topology variations. These results suggest that graph-structured hand representations can effectively support dexterous grasp generation across robot hands with different kinematic structures. Project: https://lysees.github.io/graspgraphnet-page

摘要（中文）：跨机器人手的灵巧抓取生成具有挑战性，因为不同机器人的手在运动学拓扑结构、驱动维度及原生指令空间上存在差异。我们提出GraspGraphNet——一种拓扑感知的抓取生成框架，它将每只机械手表示为基于URDF的运动学图，并直接生成可执行的掌部姿态与关节构型。该框架融合了分层物体表面编码、可微分正运动学及动态世界边消息传递机制，以建模机器人—物体间不断演化的交互过程。它直接在可执行的掌部姿态与关节状态空间应用条件流匹配，避免了后处理优化、逆运动学求解及重定向步骤。在Barrett Hand、Allegro Hand与Shadow Hand这三种机械手上训练的共享模型，在40个物体的基准测试中实现了平均83.48%的成功率，且每次抓取的推理时间为40毫秒。未经重新训练，同一模型在受控手指缺失变体上仍达到72.70%的成功率，展现出对机械手拓扑变化的鲁棒性。这些结果表明，图结构的机械手表示能够有效支持具有不同运动学结构的跨机器人手灵巧抓取生成。项目主页：https://lysees.github.io/graspgraphnet-page

Authors: Yeonseo Lee, Taeyeop Lee, Hyosup Shin, Guebin Hwang, Sungho Jo

Learning to Navigate Efficiently with Only 0.58M Trainable Parameters VLN

decomposed navigation analytic geometry residual diffusion generator point-goal navigation few-parameter training

简要说明：一种分解式视觉导航模型，利用解析几何和仅0.58M可训练参数，达到了与大规模端到端策略相当的性能，拥有快速推理和低碰撞率。

TLDR: A decomposed visual navigation model using analytic geometry and only 0.58M trainable parameters achieves performance comparable to large-scale end-to-end policies, with fast inference and low collision rates.

Abstract: Recent progress in visual navigation has largely been driven by scale: end-to-end policies with hundreds of millions of parameters trained on billions of frames or large-scale simulated data. We ask how much of this scale a single task family actually requires, and what structure can substitute for it. We propose a decomposed navigation model in which operations with known closed-form structure, such as projective geometry, occupancy, and coordinate transforms, are computed analytically and serve as interfaces between three small learned modules: an egress predictor that grounds the episode goal as a local subgoal in the current view, a navigation predictor that estimates a goal-conditioned posterior over where trajectories travel, and an endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator that samples trajectory shapes from this posterior. The system trains only 0.58M out of a total of 22.7M parameters, on 44k frames in under one GPU-hour, yet approaches the performance of state-of-the-art models on navigation tasks across 6060 point-goal episodes and 60 environments, while having 233x fewer trainable parameters, the lowest collision rate among all evaluated methods, and 50 Hz inference speed. The decomposition further transfers to no-goal exploration by retraining only the 123k-parameter egress head, and its failure modes under sensor corruption are transparent and analytically correctable.

摘要（中文）：近期视觉导航领域的进展主要受规模驱动：基于数十亿帧或大规模模拟数据训练的、拥有数亿参数的端到端策略。我们探究单个任务族究竟需要多大程度的规模，以及何种结构可以替代这种规模。我们提出一种分解式导航模型，其中具有已知闭式结构的操作（如投影几何、占据状态和坐标变换）通过解析方式计算，并作为三个小型学习模块之间的接口：出口预测器（将情景目标在当前视图中具体化为局部子目标）、导航预测器（估计目标条件下轨迹路径的后验分布），以及端点固定的残差扩散生成器（从该后验分布中采样轨迹形状）。该系统在不到1 GPU小时的训练时间内，仅使用44k帧数据，从总计22.7M参数中训练了0.58M参数，却在涵盖6060个点目标情景和60个环境的导航任务中接近最先进模型的性能，同时具有比所有评估方法少233倍的可训练参数、最低碰撞率以及50Hz推理速度。该分解方法进一步通过仅重训练12.3万参数的出口头部即可迁移至无目标探索场景，其在传感器损坏情况下的失效模式具有透明性且可通过解析方法修正。

Authors: Edward Beng Wai Tan, Siew-Kei Lam

SegDiff: Segmented Trajectory Diffusion for Consistent and Adaptive Robot Manipulation Manipulation

imitation learning diffusion models keypose visuomotor policy robot manipulation

简要说明：SegDiff 是一种闭环视觉运动策略，通过将演示分解为运动片段，并利用扩散模型和 DDIM 反演实现长时域、实时的机器人操作，结合了短期连续动作预测和关键姿态方法的优势。

TLDR: SegDiff is a closed-loop visuomotor policy that combines short-horizon continuous action prediction and keypose-based methods by decomposing demonstrations into motion segments and using diffusion models with DDIM inversion for long-horizon, real-time robot manipulation.

Abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations by mapping observations to actions. Existing approaches predict either short-horizon continuous action sequences or discrete keyposes. However, continuous prediction methods suffer from compounding errors due to short prediction horizons and struggle with multi-modal action distributions, whereas keypose-based methods necessitate an external planner, constraining real-time applicability. To address these challenges, we introduce SegDiff, a closed-loop visuomotor policy that integrates the strengths of both paradigms. SegDiff decomposes demonstrations into motion segments between keyposes and learns to predict the continuous trajectory from the current state to the next keypose, enabling long-horizon prediction with real-time refinement. Furthermore, we leverage the capability of diffusion models and DDIM inversion to propose a Dynamic Temporal Ensembling mechanism, which allows the policy to efficiently respond to dynamic environments and mitigate discontinuities caused by inconsistent multi-modal sampling. SegDiff demonstrates significant performance gains over existing approaches across various simulated and real-world scenarios, indicating its strong ability to reason over extended temporal dependencies while maintaining real-time adaptability and control stability.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习使机器人能够通过将观测映射到动作，从示范中获取操作技能。现有方法要么预测短时域连续动作序列，要么预测离散关键位姿。然而，连续预测方法因预测时域较短而存在累积误差问题，且难以应对多模态动作分布；而基于关键位姿的方法需要外部规划器，限制了实时应用能力。为解决这些挑战，我们提出SegDiff——一种融合两种范式优势的闭环视觉运动策略。SegDiff将示范分解为关键位姿间的运动片段，并学习从当前状态到下一个关键位姿的连续轨迹预测，从而在实时优化的同时实现长时域预测。此外，我们利用扩散模型与DDIM反转能力，提出动态时序集成机制，使策略能够高效响应动态环境，并缓解因不一致的多模态采样导致的轨迹不连续问题。在多种仿真与真实场景中，SegDiff相较于现有方法展现出显著的性能提升，表明其在保持实时适应性与控制稳定性的同时，具备对长时域依赖关系的强推理能力。

Authors: Haidong Cao, Wenjun Cao, Quanhao Li, Sicheng Xie, Zhiying Du, Jiaqi Leng, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

Think When It Matters: Conditional VLM Reasoning for Social Navigation with RL Policies VLN

social robot navigation hybrid architecture vision-language model reinforcement learning policy real-time deployment

简要说明：HUMA 是一种混合社交导航架构，能在人类进入敏感区域时动态切换快速RL策略和VLM推理模块，在基准测试和真实机器人上提升了任务成功率并减少了社交违规。

TLDR: HUMA is a hybrid social navigation architecture that dynamically switches between a fast RL policy and a VLM-based reasoning module when humans enter sensitive zones, improving success rates and reducing social violations on benchmarks and a real robot.

Abstract: As mobile robots become more integrated into everyday human environments, social robot navigation is becoming essential for ensuring human comfort, safety, and trust. While reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policies provide the fast inference and reactive behavior necessary for real-time deployment, they still lack flexible semantic reasoning capabilities and often fail to generalize to complex social scenarios. Recent approaches have increasingly turned to vision-language models (VLMs) in place of RL policies to improve semantic and social reasoning in robot navigation. Nevertheless, their high computational cost and slow inference remain major barriers to real-time deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HUMA (Hybrid Understanding for Multi-modal social Navigation), a hybrid architecture that dynamically balances the computational efficiency of RL policies with the deep semantic understanding of VLMs. Our approach uses a reactive RL policy to handle low-density, routine navigation tasks, while conditioning it on a post-trained high-level VLM when a human enters sensitive situations, such as the robot's proximity zone. We evaluate HUMA on the Social-MP3D and Social-HM3D benchmarks, where it achieves task success improvements of 20% and 3%, respectively, while significantly reducing personal space violations and human collisions against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive ablation studies validate each architectural component, and real-world deployment on the Mirokaï mobile robot further demonstrates the practical viability of our approach.

摘要（中文）：随着移动机器人日益融入人类日常生活环境，社交机器人导航对于确保人类舒适度、安全性和信任度变得至关重要。尽管基于强化学习（RL）的导航策略能够提供实时部署所需的快速推理和反应式行为，但其仍缺乏灵活的语义推理能力，且难以泛化至复杂社交场景。近期研究逐渐转向采用视觉语言模型（VLM）替代强化学习策略，以提升机器人导航中的语义与社交推理能力。然而，其高昂的计算成本和缓慢的推理速度仍是实时部署的主要障碍。为解决这些局限，我们提出HUMA（面向多模态社交导航的混合理解架构），这是一种动态平衡强化学习策略计算效率与视觉语言模型深度语义理解的混合架构。该方法采用反应式强化学习策略处理低密度常规导航任务，并在人类进入敏感情境（如机器人接近区域）时，基于后训练的高阶视觉语言模型对其进行条件化调控。我们在Social-MP3D和Social-HM3D基准测试上评估HUMA，相较于现有最优基线，其任务成功率分别提升20%和3%，同时显著减少了个人空间侵犯与人类碰撞事件。大量消融实验验证了各架构组件的有效性，在Mirokaï移动机器人上的实际部署进一步证明了该方法的实用可行性。

Authors: Ali Ahmadi, Hamed Rahimi, Adrien Jacquet Cretides, Marie Samson, Mahdi Khoramshahi, Mohamed Chetouani

A Single Diffusion-Policy Controller for Multi-Task Block Pushing with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer Manipulation

diffusion policy reinforcement learning multi-task manipulation sim-to-real transfer block pushing

简要说明：本文通过强化学习（而非行为克隆）从零训练一个扩散策略用于多任务推块操作，并展示了零样本的仿真到现实迁移，对目标位置、形状、重量和摩擦力的变化具有鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper trains a single diffusion policy from scratch using RL (not BC) for multi-task block pushing, and demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with robustness to variations in goal positions, shape, weight, and friction.

Abstract: Diffusion policies have shown promising empirical performance in representing and learning complex maneuvers for robots using behavior cloning (BC). In this paper, we explore training diffusion policies from scratch using reinforcement learning (RL) for multi-task robotic manipulation. Specifically, we aim to train a single diffusion policy for block-pushing tasks with multiple shapes. The proposed framework features a simple policy loss function, which is a reweighted evidence lower bound used in BC-based diffusion policy training and can seamlessly serve as the policy learning module in RL algorithms. To address the exploration challenges arising from the absence of demonstrations, we incorporate reverse curriculum generation and objective-centric representations. Combined with the expressiveness of diffusion policies, our design supports learning of multi-task block-pushing policies in our sparse-reward simulation setting. We further evaluate whether the trained diffusion policy transfers in zero-shot to real-world tasks under varying environmental conditions including goal positions, block shapes, block weights and surface friction, providing evidence that this pipeline can transfer to our real-world block-pushing setup under the tested variations.

摘要（中文）：扩散策略在基于行为克隆（BC）的机器人复杂操作表征与学习任务中展现出优异的经验性能。本文探索利用强化学习（RL）从零开始训练多任务机器人操作的扩散策略。具体而言，我们旨在为多种形状的推方块任务训练单一扩散策略。所提框架采用简洁的策略损失函数——即基于BC的扩散策略训练中使用的重加权证据下界，该函数可无缝衔接为RL算法中的策略学习模块。为解决缺乏演示数据带来的探索挑战，我们引入逆向课程生成与目标中心表征。结合扩散策略的强表达能力，该设计能够在我们设置的稀疏奖励仿真环境中支持多任务推方块策略的学习。我们进一步评估了训练后的扩散策略在零样本条件下迁移至真实世界任务的表现，涉及目标位置、方块形状、方块重量和表面摩擦力等不同环境条件，实验结果表明该流程在测试的各类变化情境下均能成功迁移至真实推方块场景。

Authors: Haitong Ma, Haldun Balim, Yang Hu, Bo Dai, Na Li

Technical Report on the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge AutonomousDriving

adversarial attacks vision-language agents autonomous driving DriveLM multi-view optimization

简要说明：本文报告了针对自动驾驶视觉语言代理（VLA）的对抗攻击挑战，分析了多视角优化和印刷文字漏洞等攻击策略。

TLDR: This paper reports on a challenge for adversarial attacks against vision-language agents (VLAs) in autonomous driving, analyzing attack strategies such as multi-view optimization and typographic vulnerabilities.

Abstract: Vision-language agents (VLAs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support safety-critical reasoning. This report presents the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge on adversarial multimodal attacks against autonomous-driving VLAs. Built on DriveLM-style multi-view visual question answering, the challenge represents each scene with six synchronized camera images and a structured collection of driving-related question-answer pairs. Participants generate adversarial images and suffix-only textual perturbations that induce model responses to deviate from reference answers while preserving image fidelity and limiting textual cost. The competition comprises two phases, with Phase II adding a hidden black-box model to assess transferability. We describe the task design, submission rules, evaluation protocol, and leaderboard results, and then examine five leading submissions for which technical reports were available. Across these reports, several recurring patterns emerge: image-side attacks are favored by the suffix penalty; scene-level, multi-view optimization is more effective than treating views in isolation; QA types and graph structure provide useful priors for allocating attack budget; feature-space objectives can improve black-box transfer; and typographic content embedded in camera images exposes a persistent vulnerability in driving VLAs. These findings provide a practical reference for future robustness evaluation and defense design in multimodal autonomous-driving systems.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言智能体（VLAs）正越来越多地被用于解读复杂驾驶场景并支持安全关键推理。本报告介绍了面向自动驾驶VLAs的对抗性多模态攻击挑战赛（CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop）。该挑战基于DriveLM风格的多视角视觉问答，每个场景由六张同步摄像头图像及一组结构化的驾驶相关问答对构成。参赛者需生成对抗性图像及仅后缀形式的文本扰动，在保持图像保真度并限制文本成本的前提下，诱导模型输出偏离参考答案。竞赛分为两个阶段，第二阶段新增隐藏黑盒模型以评估迁移性。我们描述了任务设计、提交规则、评估协议及排行榜结果，并剖析了五项可获得技术报告的领先方案。这些报告中呈现出若干共性规律：后缀惩罚机制促使参赛者偏好图像侧攻击；场景级多视角优化优于独立处理各视角；问答类型与图结构为攻击预算分配提供了有效先验；特征空间目标可提升黑盒迁移性；嵌入摄像头图像的排版内容揭示了驾驶VLAs的持续性脆弱点。这些发现为多模态自动驾驶系统的未来鲁棒性评估与防御设计提供了实用参考。

Authors: Tianyuan Zhang, Zonglei Jing, Jiangfan Liu, Ligong Zhang, Ke Ma, Chengzhi Sun, Xiaohai Xu, Zhirui Zhang, Qianqian Xu, Qingming Huang, Hanyu Fang, Junhua Liu, Zheng Wang, Xiaoliang Liu, Yuanbo Li, Shuai Gui, Bin Wang, Menghe Zheng, Jing Nie, Hanyang Meng, Zeyang Zhang, Xiang Zhang, Yongxuan Zhu, Rui Ding, Hainan Li, Yongkang Zhang, Zhilei Zhu, Xianglong Kong, Jin Hu, Zonghao Ying, Yisong Xiao, Lei Chen, Haotong Qin, Jiakai Wang, Aishan Liu, Ruikai Li, Julia Karbing, Yinpeng Dong, Zhenfei Yin, Shao Jing, Xia Hu, Jingyi Xu, Juntao Dai, Xinyun Chen, Vishal M. Patel, Xianglong Liu, Dawn Song, Alan Yuille, Philip H. S. Torr, Dacheng Tao

AdvNav: Behavior-Guided Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language Navigation VLN

black-box adversarial attack vision-language navigation behavior-guided optimization gradient-free search evolutionary noise optimization

简要说明：提出AdvNav，一种黑盒对抗攻击框架，通过利用导航智能体自身的行为反馈（轨迹级与动作级信号）生成视觉扰动，在无需模型梯度的情况下破坏视觉-语言导航任务。

TLDR: Proposes AdvNav, a black-box adversarial attack framework that uses the agent's own navigation behaviors (trajectory-level and action-level signals) to generate visual perturbations that disrupt Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) without requiring model gradients.

Abstract: Despite progress in Embodied AI, Vision-and-Language Navigation systems remain vulnerable to adversarial visual disturbances. Most existing methods rely on white-box access to target model gradients, which is often unrealistic for real-world deployed systems and computationally exhaustive due to recursive backpropagation for optimization, limiting their applicability. While previous black-box methods predominantly target single-step, instantaneous decision tasks, they struggle to handle the task complexities and temporal dependencies. This highlights the need for a gradient-free attack method that can effectively disrupt the multistep sequential perception-action loop using only observable inputs and outputs. Therefore, we propose AdvNav, a behavior-guided black-box adversarial attack framework that disturbs an agent's first-person views during navigation. To construct an informative surrogate objective for effective optimization guidance in gradient-free search under the black-box setting, we design a dual-granularity behavior-based feedback, aggregating a trajectory-level performance score representing overall navigation degradation, an action-level reward score considering the potential decision risk, and a deviation indicator, all of which are extracted from the agent's self-output behaviors. This feedback guides a hybrid optimization strategy that heuristically tunes perturbation strength via adaptive updates and evolves noise spatial structure genetically, to iteratively discover the most disruptive noise configuration. Evaluated against Transformer-based HAMT and LLM-based MapGPT with two types of backbones on R2R dataset, AdvNav achieves 49.70/65.96/87.30% Attack Success Rate. The result demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of AdvNav, reveals critical perception vulnerabilities and offers insights for the design of future resilient VLN models.

摘要（中文）：尽管具身人工智能取得了进展，视觉与语言导航系统仍然容易受到对抗性视觉干扰的影响。现有方法大多依赖白盒访问目标模型梯度，而对于实际部署的系统而言，这往往不切实际，且因优化过程中需要递归反向传播而计算开销巨大，限制了其适用性。此前针对黑盒的方法主要面向单步瞬时决策任务，难以应对任务复杂性和时间依赖关系。这凸显了对一种无梯度攻击方法的需求，该方法仅利用可观测的输入和输出，就能有效破坏多步顺序感知-行动循环。为此，我们提出AdvNav，一种行为引导的黑盒对抗攻击框架，能够在导航过程中干扰智能体的第一人称视角。为了在黑盒环境下构建信息丰富的替代目标函数，以有效指导无梯度搜索，我们设计了一种基于行为的双粒度反馈机制，聚合了代表整体导航性能下降的轨迹级性能得分、考虑潜在决策风险的动作级奖励得分以及一个偏差指标，这些信息均从智能体自身输出行为中提取。该反馈引导一种混合优化策略，通过自适应更新启发式地调整扰动强度，并遗传式地演化噪声空间结构，从而迭代发现最具破坏性的噪声配置。在R2R数据集上，针对基于Transformer的HAMT和基于LLM的MapGPT（两种骨干网络）进行评估，AdvNav实现了49.70%/65.96%/87.30%的攻击成功率。该结果证明了AdvNav的有效性和通用性，揭示了关键的感知脆弱性，并为未来鲁棒性VLN模型的设计提供了见解。

Authors: Chenyang Li, Kaige Li, Zeyu Jiang, Changhao Chen

Robust bipedal locomotion on flowable slopes via foot-driven terrain manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

bipedal locomotion granular slopes terrain manipulation cleated feet robophysical biped

简要说明：本文研究了通过带棱纹的足部进行地形操控如何改善双足机器人在颗粒斜坡上的行走，发现中等棱纹间距能将作用力分散从而使基底应力维持在屈服阈值附近，使机器人物理双足能在30度斜坡上行走，并展示了这些原理向更大自主双足机器人的迁移。

TLDR: This paper investigates how foot-driven terrain manipulation via cleated feet can improve bipedal locomotion on granular slopes, revealing that intermediate cleat spacing distributes forces to maintain substrate stresses near the yield threshold, enabling robophysical bipeds to walk on slopes up to 30 degrees, and demonstrates transfer of these principles to a larger autonomous biped.

Abstract: Bipedal robots are challenging to control because they operate close to instability, where small variations in foot-terrain contact can rapidly destabilize locomotion. On rigid terrain, bipedal robots mitigate this fragility by using well-established contact mechanics and control strategies. On flowable surfaces such as granular slopes, foot contact can induce large surface deformations and solid-fluid-like transitions, coupling terrain effects with robot dynamics, leading to underperformance or failure. This is partly due to the lack of reliable methods to represent the dynamics of flowable terrain, making it difficult to account for terrain effects in locomotion design. Here, we investigate how controlling terrain response can improve bipedal locomotion on granular slopes by studying the terradynamics of cleated feet, thin plates emanating from the foot soles. Systematic studies of a small-scale (1.4 kg) robophysical biped reveal that cleats with sparse and dense spacing lead to excessive terrain yielding and resistance, respectively, degrading performance and leading to failure. An intermediate cleat spacing distributes interaction forces to maintain substrate stresses near (or below) the yield threshold, enabling walking on granular slopes up to 30 degrees. Guided by these principles, we design a foot that actively adjusts cleat depth and accommodates both rigid and granular terrain. We also demonstrate that the principles of effective foot-terrain interaction translate to a larger (15 kg) autonomous biped. Our study presents an alternative to conventional body-centric robot control approaches, which regulate terrain-induced effects through body motion, by instead regulating terrain interactions through limb-centric approach.

摘要（中文）：双足机器人因在接近失稳状态运行而面临控制挑战，此时足部与地形接触的微小变化便可能快速导致运动失稳。在刚性地形上，双足机器人通过成熟的接触力学与控制策略缓解这种脆弱性。而在颗粒斜坡等可流动表面，足部接触会引发显著的地表形变与固-流态转变，使地形效应与机器人动力学产生耦合，导致性能下降或任务失败。这一困境部分源于缺乏可靠方法表征可流动地形的动力学特性，使得运动设计中难以考量地形影响。本研究通过分析带齿足（从足底延伸出的薄板结构）的地形动力学，探究如何通过调控地形响应来优化颗粒斜坡上的双足运动。针对小型（1.4千克）机器人物理双足系统的系统研究表明：疏齿与密齿布局分别导致过度地形屈服与过大阻力，从而降低性能并引发失效；而中等间距的齿分布能优化交互力分布，使基底应力维持在屈服阈值（或以下），从而支持在坡度达30度的颗粒斜坡上行走。基于这些原理，我们设计了可主动调节齿深并兼容刚性/颗粒地形的足部结构。研究进一步证明，有效足-地交互原理可迁移至大型（15千克）自主双足机器人。本研究提出了传统以躯干为中心的机器人控制方法的替代方案——后者通过身体运动调节地形诱发效应——转而采用以肢体为中心的调控策略，通过主动控制地形交互实现运动稳定。

Authors: Deniz Kerimoglu, Junnosuke Kamohara, Jiyeon Maeng, Ziwon Yoon, Seth Hutchinson, Ye Zhao, Daniel I. Goldman

A Compact Top-Loading Robot for Endovascular Interventions: Design, Control and Evaluation Manipulation

endovascular intervention pneumatic gripper leader-follower control top-loading design robotic catheter manipulation

简要说明：一种紧凑型顶部装载式血管介入机器人系统，采用气动夹爪和主从控制策略，实现对标准器械的连续操控，并在运动追踪和体外模型实验中验证了可行性。

TLDR: A compact top-loading robotic system for endovascular interventions featuring pneumatic grippers and a leader-follower control strategy enables continuous manipulation of standard instruments, validated in motion-tracking and in vitro phantom experiments.

Abstract: Robot-assisted endovascular intervention can potentially reduce radiation exposure, improve surgeon ergonomics, enable telesurgery, support active assistance and autonomy, and enhance procedural precision. However, existing systems often suffer from limited procedural coverage because constrained patient-side setups, restricted flexibility, and complex instrument exchange hinder clinical workflow integration. This work presents a compact robotic system for endovascular interventions that enables continuous translational and rotational manipulation of standard endovascular instruments. The system consists of two alternating carts with pneumatically actuated membrane grippers integrated into rotating gripper gears. Its top-loading design allows rapid exchange of instruments such as guidewires and catheters without changing the robotic setup. A leader-follower control strategy enables continuous motion despite the finite stroke of each cart. The system was evaluated in motion-tracking experiments with guidewires and catheters and in an in vitro vascular phantom. The motion-tracking experiments showed generally smooth translational and rotational motion profiles. Across all tested guidewire and catheter experiments, the mean relative tracking errors were 3.6% for translational motion and 4.1% for rotational motion. In the vascular phantom, robot-assisted navigation reached the target in most trials, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed manipulation concept under in vitro conditions. The presented robotic system demonstrates technical feasibility for continuous manipulation of standard endovascular instruments in bench-top and in vitro experiments. The compact top-loading design may ease instrument exchange and clinical workflow integration. Future work will focus on improving gripping performance, actuation speed, force feedback, and evaluation in more clinically realistic settings.

摘要（中文）：机器人辅助血管内介入治疗有望减少辐射暴露、改善外科医生人体工程学、实现远程手术、支持主动辅助与自主操作，并提升手术精度。然而，现有系统常因患者端布局受限、灵活性不足及器械交换复杂而影响临床工作流整合，导致手术覆盖范围有限。本文提出一种紧凑型血管内介入机器人系统，可实现标准血管内器械的连续平移与旋转操作。该系统由两个交替工作的推车组成，推车集成了气动薄膜夹爪与旋转夹持齿轮。其顶部装载式设计允许在不改变机器人配置的情况下快速交换导丝、导管等器械。通过主从控制策略，每个推车在有限行程内仍能实现连续运动。该系统在导丝与导管的运动追踪实验及体外血管模体实验中进行了评估。运动追踪实验显示平移与旋转运动曲线整体平滑。在所有导丝与导管实验中，平移运动平均相对追踪误差为3.6%，旋转运动为4.1%。在血管模体实验中，机器人辅助导航在多数试验中成功到达目标位置，证实了所提出操控概念在体外条件下的可行性。本文所提出的机器人系统在台架与体外实验中验证了连续操控标准血管内器械的技术可行性。其紧凑的顶部装载式设计可能简化器械交换与临床工作流整合。未来工作将聚焦于改进夹持性能、驱动速度、力反馈以及在更贴近临床场景中的评估。

Authors: Jonas Fischer, Lennart Karstensen, Franziska Mathis-Ullrich

AutoPath: Learning Transferable Goal-Conditioned Stochastic Path Prior for Safe Navigation Without Human Demonstrations Locomotion

goal-conditioned stochastic path prior safe navigation cross-platform transfer geometry-aware polar action manifold risk-sensitive utility shaping

简要说明：本文提出AutoPath，一种无需人类演示即可学习可迁移、目标条件随机路径先验的导航框架，实现了从差速驱动到四足机器人的跨平台迁移。

TLDR: This paper proposes AutoPath, a framework that learns a transferable, goal-conditioned stochastic path prior for safe robot navigation without requiring human demonstrations, enabling cross-platform transfer from differential-drive to quadruped robots.

Abstract: Real-time navigation in cluttered and dynamic environments requires collision-free and dynamically feasible motion under limited perception. However, feasible navigation behaviors are inherently multimodal because multiple paths may exist around obstacles. In this paper, we formulate navigation as learning a transferable goal-conditioned stochastic path prior that models a reusable distribution over goal-aligned geometry-consistent local paths conditioned on local observations. This formulation enables structured sampling of navigation candidates, allowing multiple feasible paths to be explored through sampling without relying on robot-specific motion constraints. To this end, we introduce a goal-aligned canonical state representation that removes in-plane rotational ambiguity and normalizes local geometry with respect to the goal, enabling rotation-invariant path distribution learning. We further develop a structured prior learning framework that parameterizes local paths using a geometry-aware polar action manifold and incorporates risk-sensitive utility shaping with multi-goal distributional rollouts for stable and safety-aware planning. Extensive experiments in dense static environments and dynamic pedestrian scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistently high success rates with competitive efficiency while enabling cross-platform transfer of a single path prior learned on differential-drive robots to quadruped platforms without retraining.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱动态环境中的实时导航需要在有限感知条件下实现无碰撞且动力学可行的运动。然而，可行的导航行为本质上是多模态的，因为障碍物周围可能存在多条路径。本文将导航问题表述为学习一种可迁移的、以目标为条件的随机路径先验，该先验基于局部观测对目标对齐且几何一致的局部路径上的可复用分布进行建模。这种表述实现了导航候选路径的结构化采样，允许通过采样探索多条可行路径，且无需依赖机器人特定的运动约束。为此，我们引入了一种目标对齐的规范状态表示，该表示消除了平面内的旋转模糊性，并针对目标对局部几何结构进行归一化，从而实现旋转不变的路径分布学习。我们进一步开发了一种结构化先验学习框架，该框架利用几何感知的极坐标动作流形参数化局部路径，并结合多目标分布展开进行风险敏感效用整形，以实现稳定且具备安全意识的规划。在密集静态环境与动态行人场景中的大量实验表明，所提方法能够以具有竞争力的效率持续实现高成功率，同时支持将从差速驱动机器人上学习到的单一路径先验跨平台迁移至四足机器人平台，而无需重新训练。

Authors: Ziyang Zhang, Boyang Zhou, Zesong Yang, Haocheng Peng, Zeming Gai, Xiao Liang, Yujun Shen, Danping Zou, Ruizhen Hu, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

Stop to Decide: Latency-Aware Proprioceptive Navigation Primitives for Mapping-Free Quadruped Inspection Locomotion

proprioceptive navigation quadruped inspection latency-aware climb-settle cadence mapping-free

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向四足机器人的时延感知、无地图本体感导航系统，解决了因算力受限导致控制周期变慢而引发的楼梯顶部过冲问题。核心贡献是一种“攀爬-停顿”节奏，即使在低控制频率下也能保持接近零的过冲率，在Unitree Go2上完成巡检任务的成功率为90%。

TLDR: This paper presents a latency-aware, mapping-free proprioceptive navigation stack for quadruped robots that addresses the problem of overshooting stair tops due to compute-limited control loops. The key contribution is a climb-settle cadence that maintains near-zero overshoot even at low loop rates, demonstrated on a Unitree Go2 completing an inspection course with 90% success.

Abstract: Compute-constrained quadrupeds often run their navigation loop far below the controller's design rate: sharing the onboard Jetson Orin with the vision pipeline slows our stair loop to about 15 Hz. This latency breaks a standard proprioceptive pattern: declaring stair-summit arrival from the body-pitch signal while still climbing. On a stepped platform whose 50 cm top is shorter than the robot (Unitree Go2, about 75 cm), in-motion detection overshoots the top edge with probability rising with the per-period advance v/f (the slowest about 15 Hz cell partly diluted by a separate non-arrival mode), whereas a climb-settle cadence holds overshoot near zero at every loop rate (pooled 22/45 vs 1/45 over about 30/20/15 Hz; Fisher p about 2.4e-7; 7/15 vs 0/15 at the deployed about 15 Hz). A logistic dose-response model in v/f captures the failure; a pre-specified 40 Hz out-of-sample test favours the protocol-clean fit (33% observed vs 43%/22% predicted), giving a deployment rule (critical loop rate about 19 Hz at 0.30 m/s). The detector sits in a fully onboard, mapping-free and learning-free stack: built-in inertial measurement unit, four foot-force channels, three 1-D ranges, one line camera, chaining line-following, a three-segment maneuver for 90-degree corners in a 55 cm corridor (20/20 contact-free vs 14/20 with 12 wall contacts for in-place yaw; exit-heading error 1.56 degrees vs 5.64 degrees), and stair traversal, completing the inspection course in 18/20 trials (90%). Results are from a single course geometry, platform, and operator.

摘要（中文）：计算受限的四足机器人通常以其导航循环运行速度远低于控制器的设计频率：与视觉流水线共享机载Jetson Orin时，其楼梯循环速度降至约15 Hz。这一延迟破坏了标准本体感受模式——在攀爬过程中通过身体俯仰信号判定楼梯平台到达。当机器人（Unitree Go2，长约75 cm）位于顶部长度为50 cm的阶梯平台时，运动中的检测会越过顶部边缘，其概率随周期前进速度v/f增加而上升（最慢约15 Hz单元部分被独立的非到达模式稀释），而攀爬-稳定节奏在所有循环速度下均将越界概率维持在近零水平（合并数据：约30/20/15 Hz条件下为22/45 vs 1/45；Fisher检验p值约2.4e-7；部署约15 Hz条件下为7/15 vs 0/15）。基于v/f的逻辑斯谛剂量-响应模型可解释该失效现象；预设40 Hz的样本外测试支持协议清洁拟合（观测值33% vs 预测值43%/22%），由此给出部署规则（临界循环速度约19 Hz，对应0.30 m/s速度）。检测器位于完全机载、无地图依赖、无需学习的堆栈中：内置惯性测量单元、四通道足底力传感器、三个一维测距仪、一台线阵相机，串联实现线跟踪、三段式机动以在55 cm走廊完成90度转弯（20/20无接触 vs 原地偏航的14/20及12次墙壁接触；出口航向误差1.56度 vs 5.64度），以及楼梯穿越，在18/20次试验中完成检测路线（90%）。结果基于单一路线几何构型、平台和操作员。
