Authors: Hanting Suo, Haonan Yan, Liang Wang, Aiguo Song

Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching Manipulation

semantic-to-actuation grounding flow matching soft continuum robot whole-body motion human-robot interaction

简要说明：本文提出了一种框架，通过轻量级流匹配将多模态大语言模型的语义命令转换为软体连续体机器人的全身运动，显著提升了正确性和用户满意度。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework for grounding semantic commands from a multimodal LLM into whole-body motions of a soft continuum trunk robot using lightweight flow matching, significantly improving correctness and user satisfaction in HRI.

Abstract: For close-contact human-robot interaction (HRI), trunk-like continuum manipulators provide a physical channel for diverse whole-body expression, but grounding open-vocabulary responses into such robots is difficult: end-effector motion underspecifies body shape, whereas direct whole-body commands are high-dimensional and hard to keep feasible. We propose a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk HRI based on lightweight flow matching. The framework converts responses from a multimodal large language model into bounded, morphology-aligned intent-intensity tuples, parameterizes tendon-actuation trajectories with compact Catmull-Rom spline controls, and uses a rectified-flow generator to sample feasible whole-body trunk motions. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves held-out grounding correctness from 25.0% to 77.2% over a raw-response dense-regression baseline. Compared with a denoising-diffusion baseline, it improves correctness from 71.9% to 77.2% and reduces inference time from 7.86 ms to 4.87 ms while preserving motion diversity. A 100-participant physical HRI study further shows that adding the generated soft-trunk motion channel increases the positive overall-satisfaction rating from 46% to 82% over the audiovisual-only baseline.

摘要（中文）：对于近距离人机交互，象鼻型连续体机械臂为多样化的全身表达提供了物理通道，但将开放词汇响应映射到此类机器人存在困难：末端执行器运动无法完整定义形体，而直接操控全身动作则维度高且难以保证可行性。我们提出了一种基于轻量流匹配的类象软鼻人机交互全身语义-驱动映射框架。该框架将多模态大语言模型的响应转化为有界且符合形态特征的意图强度元组，通过紧凑的Catmull-Rom样条控制参数化肌腱驱动轨迹，并采用整流流生成器采样可行的全身象鼻运动。实验表明，相较于原始响应的密集回归基线，所提框架将留出验证集上的映射正确率从25.0%提升至77.2%。与去噪扩散基线相比，正确率从71.9%提升至77.2%，推理时间从7.86毫秒缩短至4.87毫秒，同时保持运动多样性。包含100名参与者的实物人机交互研究进一步表明，在纯视听基线基础上增加生成的软鼻运动通道，使总体满意度正向评分从46%提升至82%。

Authors: Tingcong Liu, Tongshun Chen, Siyi Ma, Yuhao Wang, Aye Phyu Phyu Aung, Ibrahim Alsarraj, J. Senthilnath, Bo An, Ke Wu

Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion Manipulation

affordance recognition action effect prediction text goal matching sim-to-real real-to-sim image conversion

简要说明：一种基于 affordance 识别和动作效果预测的操作规划系统，通过文本目标匹配和真实到仿真图像转换实现仿真到现实的泛化。

TLDR: A manipulation planning system that uses affordance recognition, action effect prediction, and text-based goal matching, with a real-to-sim image conversion module for sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: We present a manipulation planning system based on affordance recognition and action effect prediction. The system reasons through possible futures in visual form, and evaluates candidate plans by agreement of predicted outcomes with text-based goals set at run-time, using a multi-modal goal-matching module. Positions of objects named in the goal text are tracked through predictions even when occluded, making it possible to generate action plans even when objects become occluded, or when their initial descriptors cease to identify them in future states. We further expand the system with an image conversion module for translating real-world state images with objects of varied shapes and visual appearances into a consistent visual appearance, to facilitate manipulation planning in a physical robot setup. We evaluate performance of the system's modules in isolation and demonstrate the integrated system's manipulation planning capabilities on a set of challenging tasks in both simulation and on hardware.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种基于可供性识别与动作效果预测的操控规划系统。该系统以视觉形式对可能的未来状态进行推理，并通过多模态目标匹配模块，依据预测结果与运行时设定的基于文本的目标的一致性来评估候选规划。即使目标物体被遮挡，系统仍能通过预测追踪目标文本中命名的物体位置，从而在物体被遮挡或其初始描述符无法在未来状态中识别时，仍能生成动作规划。我们进一步扩展了系统，增加了一个图像转换模块，用于将包含不同形状和视觉外观物体的真实世界状态图像转换为一致的视觉外观，以支持在实体机器人平台上的操控规划。我们分别评估了系统各模块的性能，并在仿真环境与硬件平台上通过一系列具有挑战性的任务展示了集成系统的操控规划能力。

Authors: Solvi Arnold, Rin Karashima, Tadashi Adachi, Takafumi Mochizuki, Kimitoshi Yamazaki

Wearing A Coat: Dual-Arm Robot-Assisted Dressing with Differentiable Clothing Simulation Manipulation

robot-assisted dressing differentiable clothing simulation dual-arm manipulation contact constraints multi-phase control

简要说明：本文提出了一种机器人辅助穿衣算法，该算法结合了实时可微布料仿真与多阶段控制策略，使双臂机器人能够协助穿外套。

TLDR: This paper presents a robot-assisted dressing algorithm that integrates real-time differentiable clothing simulation with a multi-phase control strategy, enabling a dual-arm robot to assist in putting on a coat.

Abstract: The development of assistive robots for dressing tasks serves to augment human convenience and improve the quality of life for individuals with physical impairments. However, due to the intricate contact interactions between garments and the human limbs during dressing, most robot-assisted dressing algorithms treat clothing as an assembly of discrete segments, thereby struggling to manage the partial worn garments under contact constraints. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel robotic dressing control algorithm that integrates realtime differentiable clothing simulation. The simulation algorithm employs explicit iterative scheme with intentionally introduced higher-order perturbations to enhance computational efficiency while maintaining stability under large time-step conditions. Through simulation, we resolve the garment state under contact constraints, which then enables a multi-phase control strategy for successful coat dressing assistance. To further improve real-time performance, we introduce a constrained local model along with its corresponding optimization solver, permitting high-frequency local compensation for the differentiable simulation based global controller. Finally, we experimentally validate our approach through both simulated and physical dressing scenarios, conclusively demonstrating its feasibility and efficacy

摘要（中文）：摘要： 用于穿衣任务的辅助机器人发展旨在提升人类生活的便利性，并改善肢体功能障碍者生活质量。然而，由于穿衣过程中衣物与人体肢体间存在复杂的接触交互，多数机器人辅助穿衣算法将衣物视为离散片段组合，难以处理接触约束下部分穿戴的衣物。为攻克这一难题，我们提出一种融合实时可微布料模拟的新型机器人穿衣控制算法。该模拟算法采用显式迭代方案，通过引入高阶扰动提升计算效率，同时在大时间步长条件下保持稳定性。通过模拟方法，我们解析了接触约束下的衣物状态，进而实现一种多阶段控制策略以完成外套穿衣辅助。为进一步提升实时性能，我们引入带约束的局部模型及其对应优化求解器，从而为基于可微模拟的全局控制器提供高频局部补偿。最终，我们通过仿真与实体穿衣场景实验验证了该方法的有效性，确证了其可行性与效能。

Authors: Yiming Liu, Lijun Han, Hesheng Wang

Real-Time Rulebook-Aware Nonlinear MPC for Autonomous Driving with Priority-Biased Tiered Slacks AutonomousDriving

nonlinear MPC rule-based planning priority-biased slacks autonomous driving real-time control

简要说明：本文提出W-SQP，一种用于自动驾驶的实时非线性MPC，通过加权分层松弛量优先处理规则违反，在Waymo数据上评估。

TLDR: This paper presents W-SQP, a real-time nonlinear MPC for autonomous driving that uses weighted tiered slacks to prioritize rule violations, evaluated on Waymo data.

Abstract: Autonomous-vehicle motion planners must resolve conflicts among safety, regulation, comfort, and efficiency in real time while exposing those decisions for audit. We present W-SQP, a weighted tiered-slack nonlinear model predictive controller (NMPC) that compiles nine driving-rule families into a four-tier shared-slack nonlinear program solved online with CasADi and IPOPT; the name denotes the weighted quadratic slack penalty, not a sequential-quadratic-programming solver. Strongly separated tier penalties bias residual violations toward lower-priority rules while leaving actuation bounds hard. The controller replans from its executed state at $10$\,Hz and records per-rule residuals on every cycle. A $90$\,ms solver-time limit returns an anytime iterate that is projected through the vehicle dynamics before execution; median and maximum observed wall-clock solve times were $28$ and $104$\,ms. We evaluate W-SQP in closed loop on 150 Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios in Waymax against reactive and proposal-and-select baselines, and introduce a log-independent protocol that separates safety and regulatory compliance from resemblance to the recorded human trajectory. Under this protocol, W-SQP shows no systematic group-level deficit relative to expert replay on the log-independent safety and regulatory rules, with several localized regressions in the hardest, highest-divergence scenarios. The results characterize W-SQP as an auditable, priority-biased, anytime-capable NMPC prototype rather than a hard-real-time or formally safe controller.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶运动规划器必须在实时环境中解决安全、法规、舒适性与效率之间的冲突，同时使这些决策可被审计。我们提出W-SQP——一种加权分层松弛非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），它将九类驾驶规则族编译为四层共享松弛非线性规划问题，并通过CasADi与IPOPT在线求解；其名称指代加权二次松弛罚函数，而非序列二次规划求解器。强分离的层级惩罚项将残余违规优先导向低优先级规则，同时保持执行界限的硬约束。该控制器以10赫兹频率从已执行状态重新规划，并在每个周期记录各类规则的残差。通过90毫秒求解器时限，返回的任意时刻迭代解在执行前需经车辆动力学投影；实测中位与最长壁钟求解时间分别为28毫秒与104毫秒。我们在Waymax平台上基于150个Waymo开放运动数据集场景，将W-SQP与反应式基线及提议-选择基线进行闭环评估，并引入一种独立于日志的评估协议，该协议将安全性与法规合规性分离于对记录的人类轨迹的相似性度量。在此协议下，W-SQP在独立于日志的安全与法规规则上未表现出系统性的群体级缺陷，仅在难度最高、分歧最大的场景中出现若干局部退化。结果表明，W-SQP被定性为一种可审计、优先偏置、具备任意时刻计算能力的NMPC原型，而非硬实时或形式化安全的控制器。

Authors: Hadi Hajieghrary, Benedikt Walter, Chaitanya Shinde, Paul Schmitt, Miguel Hurtado

Edge Physical AI Deployment of Vision Transformers on Heterogeneous Edge GPU Targeting Autonomous Vehicles AutonomousDriving

edge inference vision transformer heterogeneous deployment frame scheduling autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出H-FraDS，一种面向自动驾驶的硬件感知帧调度方法，用于在异构边缘GPU上部署视觉Transformer，在保持可接受的精度的同时实现了显著的加速和能效提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes H-FraDS, a hardware-aware frame scheduling methodology for deploying vision transformers on heterogeneous edge GPUs for autonomous driving, achieving significant speedup and energy efficiency while maintaining acceptable accuracy.

Abstract: Physical AI systems, such as autonomous vehicles and intelligent machines, require transformer-based perception models that satisfy stringent edge latency and energy constraints. However, heterogeneous edge-GPU deployment remains limited by underutilized hardware engines and accelerator-incompatible operators, causing fragmented execution and lower throughput per watt. This paper presents Heterogeneous Frame Dispatch Scheduling (H-FraDS), a hardware-aware frame scheduling methodology for transformer inference on a recent NVIDIA edge GPU. H-FraDS routes frames across the GPU and dual deep learning accelerator (DLA) cores using fixed dispatch ratios to improve utilization under latency and power constraints. To enable scheduling, incompatible transformer components are adapted for DLA execution by reshaping tensors, approximating error function (ERF) with tanh, and replacing layer normalization with bounded tanh. The adapted model maintains a 92% F1 score, with only a 2% reduction from the original. Optical flow accelerator (OFA) is further used for inference-side optical-flow estimation. To the best of the authors' knowledge, prior work has not addressed these combined issues. Using Swin Transformer for autonomous-driving perception, H-FraDS Balanced Dispatch (1:2) achieves 125.93 FPS, a 2.36x speedup over standalone adapted-DLA execution, 4.0 FPS/W, and approximately 24 ms DLA latency, satisfying 30 FPS real-time operation; the GPU-DLA-OFA case achieves a 2.02x DLA throughput speedup.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能系统（如自动驾驶车辆和智能机器）依赖于基于Transformer的感知模型，这些模型需满足严格的边缘延迟和能量约束。然而，异构边缘GPU的部署仍受限于硬件引擎利用率不足及与加速器不兼容的算子，导致执行碎片化且每瓦吞吐量较低。本文提出异构帧调度策略（H-FraDS），一种面向最新NVIDIA边缘GPU上Transformer推理的硬件感知帧调度方法。H-FraDS通过固定分配比率在GPU与双深度学习加速器核心间路由帧，以在延迟和功耗约束下提升利用率。为支持调度，通过张量重塑、利用tanh近似误差函数、以有界tanh替代层归一化等操作，将不兼容的Transformer组件适配至深度学习加速器执行。适配后模型保持92%的F1分数，仅较原始模型下降2%。光流加速器进一步用于推理侧光流估计。据作者所知，现有研究尚未同时解决上述问题。采用Swin Transformer进行自动驾驶感知时，H-FraDS均衡调度（1:2）实现125.93 FPS（较单独适配的深度学习加速器执行加速2.36倍）、4.0 FPS/W，深度学习加速器延迟约24毫秒，满足30 FPS实时运行要求；GPU-深度学习加速器-光流加速器方案下，深度学习加速器吞吐量实现2.02倍加速。

Authors: Ashiyana Abdul Majeed, Mahmoud Meribout, Neethu Joseph, Abel Kidane Haile, Mohammad Abdullah Al Faruque

Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking for Nighttime Highway Perception AutonomousDriving

event-RGB fusion adaptive tracking nighttime highway perception Extended Kalman Filter synthetic dataset

简要说明：提出了一种联合事件-RGB自适应跟踪框架（JEAT），利用自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波器实现夜间高速公路感知，并引入了一个包含同步事件和RGB数据的合成数据集（SEHN）。

TLDR: Proposes a joint event-RGB adaptive tracking framework (JEAT) with an Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter for nighttime highway perception, and introduces a synthetic dataset (SEHN) with synchronized event and RGB data.

Abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems deployed on highways predominantly rely on conventional RGB cameras for traffic perception and vehicle tracking. However, highway environments present unique challenges: the absence of artificial lighting infrastructure, combined with high vehicle velocities, results in severely degraded perception performance under low-light conditions. Specifically, nighttime scenarios suffer from motion blur, insufficient exposure, and poor signal-to-noise ratios, which catastrophically impair the reliability of RGB-based sensing systems. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Joint Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking (JEAT) framework. Unlike existing multi-sensor trackers constrained by rigid, hard-coded prioritization, JEAT merges asynchronous event streams and RGB frames into a unified joint data association optimization. By employing an Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter to continuously estimate measurement noise via NIS statistics, the framework dynamically weights and fuses both modalities, optimally harnessing event streams during dark or high-speed motion while leveraging RGB frames under bright or static conditions. Furthermore, given the absence of publicly available datasets tailored for event-based highway perception with diverse environmental conditions, we present SEHN, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated using the CARLA simulator. Our dataset encompasses diverse environmental conditions (daytime, nighttime, nighttime with out artificial lighting) and varying traffic densities, providing synchronized RGB imagery and event streams to facilitate multi-modal fusion research. Our code and datasets will be available at https://github.com/haidongwang96/SEHN.

摘要（中文）：高速公路部署的智能交通系统主要依赖传统RGB相机进行交通感知与车辆追踪。然而，高速公路环境存在特殊挑战：缺乏人工照明基础设施，加之车辆高速行驶，导致低光照条件下感知性能严重退化。具体而言，夜间场景存在运动模糊、曝光不足和信噪比差等问题，这些因素会灾难性地损害基于RGB传感系统的可靠性。为解决上述局限，我们提出一种新颖的联合事件-RGB自适应追踪（JEAT）框架。与现有受刚性硬编码优先级约束的多传感器追踪器不同，JEAT将异步事件流与RGB帧融合为统一联合数据关联优化问题。通过采用自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波器持续利用NIS统计量估计测量噪声，该框架能动态加权并融合两种模态，在黑暗或高速运动时充分利用事件流，在明亮或静态条件下则侧重RGB帧。此外，针对目前缺乏适用于不同环境条件下基于事件的高速公路感知公开数据集的问题，我们提出SEHN——利用CARLA模拟器生成的大规模合成数据集。该数据集涵盖多种环境条件（日间、夜间、无人工照明夜间）及不同交通密度，提供同步RGB图像与事件流以促进多模态融合研究。我们的代码与数据集将发布在https://github.com/haidongwang96/SEHN。

Authors: Haidong Wang, Hengxing Cai, Wanlei Li, Xiaogang Xiong, Renxin Zhong

CR-Solver: GPU-Accelerated Kinematics Solver for Tendon-driven Continuum Robots Manipulation

tendon-driven continuum robots GPU-accelerated parallel optimization inverse kinematics path following trajectory planning

简要说明：CR-Solver 是一个用于肌腱驱动连续型机器人的 GPU 加速运动学求解器，它将逆运动学、路径跟踪和轨迹规划统一在单个约束非线性优化框架中，实现了高速度和高精度。

TLDR: CR-Solver is a GPU-accelerated, optimization-based kinematics solver for tendon-driven continuum robots that unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning in a single constrained nonlinear optimization framework, achieving high speed and accuracy.

Abstract: Continuum robots provide intrinsic compliance, high dexterity, and safe physical interaction, enabling navigation and manipulation in confined and unstructured environments. Despite recent advances in sensing and control, heightening the need for precise motion generation, most widely used planning libraries are grounded in rigid-body assumptions, creating a critical gap for fast and practical tools for continuum robots. To address this, we present CR-Solver, a two-stage, optimization-based solver for the motion generation of tendon-driven continuum robots. Our method unifies inverse kinematics, path following, and trajectory planning within a single constrained nonlinear optimization framework. Leveraging GPU-accelerated parallel optimization, CR-Solver delivers fast, accurate, and constraint-aware solutions. We validate our approach on three tasks, demonstrating significant speedups over traditional CPU-based solvers while achieving a consistently high success rate above 95% and millimeter-level accuracy. The solver is implemented in pure Python, reducing the barrier to adoption and offering a practical, extensible foundation for continuum robots' high-performance motion planning.

摘要（中文）：连续体机器人具有内在柔顺性、高灵活性和安全物理交互能力，可在受限及非结构化环境中实现导航与操作。尽管传感与控制技术的最新进展提升了对精确运动生成的需求，但当前广泛使用的规划库仍基于刚体假设，导致缺乏适用于连续体机器人的快速实用工具。为解决这一问题，我们提出CR-Solver——一种面向绳驱连续体机器人的两阶段优化求解器。该方法将逆运动学、路径跟踪与轨迹规划统一在单一约束非线性优化框架内。通过利用GPU加速并行优化技术，CR-Solver能够提供快速、精确且满足约束的求解方案。我们在三项任务中验证了该方法，结果表明其相较于传统CPU求解器实现显著加速，同时保持95%以上的稳定高成功率与毫米级精度。该求解器采用纯Python实现，降低了应用门槛，为连续体机器人的高性能运动规划提供了实用且可扩展的基础框架。

Authors: Heqing Yang, Yang Yi, Linqing Zhong, Linjiang Huang, Si Liu

3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments Perception3D

3D scene graph graph diffusion model floor plan prediction partial observation hierarchical scene generation

简要说明：本文提出了一种自顶向下的框架，利用混合域图扩散模型从部分观测的环境中预测分层3D场景图（房间布局和物体排列），面向探索和物体搜索等机器人任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes a top-down framework that uses a mixed-domain graph diffusion model to predict hierarchical 3D scene graphs (room layout and object arrangement) from partially observed environments, targeting robotics tasks like exploration and object search.

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D indoor scenes is an area of growing interest in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods, often motivated by applications such as interior design, generally focus on object layout generation within a single room. The generation of high-level scene structure, such as room-level layout and traversability, remains underexplored despite its importance for robotics applications. In this paper, we consider the case where a robot has explored part of an environment and needs to predict the unexplored parts to support downstream tasks such as exploration or object search. We propose a top-down framework for synthesizing hierarchical 3D scene graphs, including a room layer -- describing the floor plan and traversability -- and an object layer modeling object layouts within each room. For the room layer, we propose a novel mixed-domain graph diffusion model jointly predicting room categories, floor boundaries, and traversability between rooms. Via corruption and masking, this model supports partial constraints such as incomplete floor plans, avoiding the need for partially observed training data. For the object layer, we integrate an existing mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model for joint prediction of object categories, locations, sizes, and orientations within each room given the floor plan. We compare our method with state-of-the-art occupancy-based and LLM-based floor plan generation methods on a standard benchmark. Compared with an occupancy-based learning baseline, our method generalizes substantially better to out-of-distribution partial floor plans. We also demonstrate our integrated prediction pipeline on real-world scenes from robot-collected data, enabling prediction beyond explored areas.

摘要（中文）：生成逼真的三维室内场景是计算机视觉与机器人领域日益受到关注的研究方向。现有方法通常受室内设计等应用驱动，主要关注单房间内的物体布局生成。尽管高层次的场景结构（如房间级布局和可通行性）对机器人应用至关重要，但其生成问题仍未得到充分探索。本文考虑机器人已探索部分环境、需预测未知区域以支持探索或物体搜索等下游任务的应用场景。我们提出一种自顶向下的层次化三维场景图合成框架，包括描述楼层平面与可通行性的房间层，以及建模每个房间内物体布局的物体层。针对房间层，我们提出一种新颖的混合域图扩散模型，可联合预测房间类别、楼层边界及房间间可通行性。通过数据污染与掩码机制，该模型支持不完整楼层平面等部分约束，无需部分观测训练数据。在物体层，我们集成现有混合离散-连续扩散模型，在已知楼层平面条件下联合预测每个房间内的物体类别、位置、尺寸与朝向。我们在标准基准上将本方法与基于占用率及基于大语言模型的最新楼层平面生成方法进行比较。与基于占用率的学习基线相比，本方法对分布外部分楼层平面具有显著更强的泛化能力。我们还利用机器人采集的真实场景数据展示了集成预测流程，实现了探索区域之外的预测功能。

Authors: Siyi H, Jared Strade, Hyungtae Lim, Luca Carlone

Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency WorldModel

video world models error accumulation cycle consistency reverse prediction long-term generation

简要说明：提出Cycle-World框架，通过反向预测和循环一致性来减少自回归扩散模型在长视频生成中的误差累积，提升稳定性。

TLDR: Proposes Cycle-World, a framework using reverse-prediction and cycle-consistency to stabilize long-term video generation by mitigating error accumulation in autoregressive diffusion models.

Abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by enforcing strict temporal reversibility across both the training and inference phases. Theoretically, we demonstrate that forward generative drift can be strictly bottlenecked by a cycle-consistency objective. During training, we integrate an efficient reverse-prediction model to implicitly embed causal constraints into the forward generator, compelling it to produce reversible sequences that tightly adhere to the natural video manifold. At inference time, we repurpose this frozen reverse model as a runtime corrector. Through gradient-based cycle guidance, it iteratively refines the generated latent representations, actively suppressing accumulated errors before they are committed to the historical context. Extensive experiments on the VBench benchmark demonstrate that Cycle-World's dual-phase synergy significantly mitigates error drift, achieving state-of-the-art overall generation quality and long-horizon temporal consistency in 60-second synthesis.

摘要（中文）：自回归扩散模型已实现高质量视频生成，但其序列特性天然存在误差累积问题。在长时域视频合成中，微小预测偏差随时间叠加，不可避免地导致无约束生成漂移、结构崩塌及严重视觉退化。针对这一问题，我们提出Cycle-World——一种面向稳定且时间一致性长视频生成的新型框架。该方法通过强制在训练与推理阶段均保持严格的时间可逆性来应对误差漂移。理论上，我们证明前向生成漂移可通过循环一致性目标进行严格约束。训练阶段，我们集成高效反向预测模型，将因果约束隐式嵌入前向生成器，迫使其生成严格贴合自然视频流形的可逆序列。推理阶段，该冻结反向模型被重新用作运行时校正器：通过基于梯度的循环引导，迭代优化生成的潜在表征，在累积误差写入历史上下文前主动抑制。在VBench基准上的大量实验表明，Cycle-World的双阶段协同效应显著缓解了误差漂移，在60秒合成中实现了最优的整体生成质量与长时域时间一致性。
